title: Data Scientist (m/f) (réf. E) (réf. F) (réf. M) (H/F)
description: Statut : Employé, Fonctionnaire Qui recrute ? Commissariat du Gouvernement à la souveraineté des données Missions Le Commissariat du gouvernement à la souveraineté des données (« CGSD ») est une administration dont les missions sont prévues par la loi du décembre . Le CGSD peut être désigné par les administrations et les communes comme délégué à la protection des données (DPO) ou assister les DPO internes que les administrations étatiques ont désignés. Il est l'organisme compétent, conformément à l'article 7, paragraphe 1er du règlement (UE) / (règlement sur la gouvernance des données), habilité à octroyer ou à refuser l'accès à certaines données protégées du secteur public et leur réutilisation. Il a également pour mission de contribuer au développement de la protection des données et de dispenser des conseils en matier/ière de gouvernance des données et de l'intelligence artificielle au sein des administrations étatiques. Il conseille, sur demande, les membres du Gouvernement pour une mise en œuvre cohérente des politiques en ces matier/ières. Enfin dans le cadre de ses missions de conseil et guidance, le CGSD sensibilise les agents publics et développe des documents et des outils adaptés visant à assister les entités en matier/ière de conformité au RGPD. Dans ce cadre, et pour renforcer le Département Autorité luxermbourgeoise des données, le CGSD recherche deux (2) Data Scientists expérimenté(e)s en matier/ière de Privacy et PETs (Privacy-Enhancing Technologies). En ce sens, il faudra pour les personnes qui candidatent être en capacité de satisfaire aux missions ci-après exposées : Concevoir et mettre en œuvre des solutions avancées en science des données, avec un focus particulier sur la protection de la vie privée et les technologies d'amélioration de la confidentialité (PETs); Analyser et modéliser des données complexes, développer des algorithmes de machine learning et évaluer leur performance; Identifier et mitiger les risques liés à la confidentialité et à la réidentification dans les projets data et IA, Contribuer à la définition de standards et bonnes pratiques en matier/ière d'anonymisation, pseudonymisation et gestion des données sensibles; Collaborer avec les équipes métier et techniques pour intégrer les contraintes de privacy dans les pipelines de données et les modèles IA; Réaliser des analyses approfondies de qualité des données, de lignée et de conformité privacy; Assurer une veille scientifique et technique sur les avancées en privacy engineering et en techniques d'anonymisation. Profil Compétences techniques Les candidat(e)s devront faire preuve d'un véritable niveau d'expertise, à savoir: Expertise Data: Expertise poussée en modélisation de données, data lineage, data quality et data governance; Maîtrise des environnements Big Data, bases relationnelles et NoSQL, ainsi que des outils de traitement de données massives; Solides compétences en SQL avancé et en raisonnement sur les structures de données complexes; Expérience dans la gestion et la transformation de données sensibles dans des environnements réglementés; Expertise solide sur les standards et modèles de données de (OMOP CDM, OpenEHR, FHIR, HL7). title: IT Security Expert (m/f)
description:
IT Security Expert
Luxembourg, LU, L-2449

Purpose of the Job

Quintet Private Bank is a leading private bank in the wealth management sector; we are committed to our clients and their families, and pride ourselves on our personalised service based on a deep understanding of what clients want to achieve.
We are a bank headquartered in Luxembourg, with branches in Belgium, Denmark, Germany, Netherlands and a subsidiary in the UK. We are supervised by the CSSF with an ambition to stay true to our purpose to be the most trusted fiduciary of family wealth.
When you join Quintet you are joining a company that values diversity of background, equal access to opportunities, career development, collaboration and inclusiveness. We want our employees to feel proud of being part of a company that is committed to do the right thing. You will have the opportunity to grow your career while developing personally and professionally through various resources and programmes.

We are looking for a skilled IT Security Expert with strong hands-on network administration expertise to join our dynamic IT Security team.
The role combines IT Security Infrastructure management with deep operational knowledge of enterprise network infrastructures, ensuring that security controls are effectively implemented, and operated across on premises, hybrid, and cloud environments.
The successful candidate will work as part of the ITS Group Function – Network & Security Team in Quintet Luxembourg.

Key Accountabilities

• Operate the Bank Security Infrastructure (Run the Bank) including firewall policies, VPNs, IPS/IDS, and mail gateways.
• Penetration Testing Coordination: Coordinate and support penetration testing efforts, analysing findings, and working with teams to address identified security weaknesses.
• Vulnerabilities Process Follow-Up: Monitor and track the status of identified vulnerabilities, ensuring that remediation efforts are executed efficiently and effectively. Manage the process and provide reporting associated
• Patching Follow-Up: Manage and oversee the patch management process including EDR follow up, ensuring timely application of security updates and addressing vulnerabilities in a proactive manner.
• Security Dashboard Creation: Develop and maintain security dashboards to provide real-time visibility into security metrics, vulnerabilities, and incident response efforts for stakeholders
• Operate the day to day data leakage prevention (DLP) and data exfiltration monitoring activities, including detection, investigation, and remediation of potential data leaks across network, endpoint, cloud, and perimeter layers.
• Technical Risk Analysis Support: Assist in conducting technical risk assessments and analyses to identify potential security threats and recommend appropriate mitigation strategies.
• Access Validation: provide guidance for specific access request by following Access control policy principles
• Maintain and secure the group network infrastructure, including Lan, Wan, SD-WAN, VPN, Bank Wireless network and cloud networking.  
• Ensure secure connectivity between on-premises environments and cloud platforms
• Collaboration: Work closely with IT teams, including CISO, to integrate security into all aspects of the organization's IT landscape.    
    
Knowledge and Experience

• 5+ years of experience in IT Security, with strong hands-on experience in enterprise network administration.
• Strong knowledge of security frameworks and best practices (e.g., NIST, ISO 27001).
• Proven experience in network and security operations within complex environments.
• Experience with penetration testing methodologies and tools.
• Familiarity with security technologies, including firewalls, IDS/IPS, and SIEM solutions.
• Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.
• Strong communication skills, with the ability to present technical information clearly to diverse audiences.
• Relevant certifications (e.g., CISSP, CEH, CISM, CCNP Security, etc) are highly desirable.  
• Ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams

Attributes and Qualities

• Adaptability & Learning Agility                        
• Time Management                                
• Communication (Verbal & Written)                    
• Client-Centric Mindset                            
• Collaborative Teamwork

Technical Skills

• Strong knowledge in Security Frameworks and Standards. Knowledge of security frameworks (ISO 27001, NIST, CIS Controls) and Compliance regulations (GDPR, DORA, etc)
• Strong knowledge Firewall Next Generation (VPN, IPS, Anti-malware, Sandbox, URL Filtering, ...); Mail & Web gateways;
• Knowledge in VPN and Remote access solutions
• Knowledge in Endpoints Security (antivirus, antimalware)
• Knowledge in Threat Intelligence and Vulnerability Management - Ability to analyse threat intelligence and conduct vulnerability assessments. Familiarity with security tools (SIEM, vulnerability scanners).  

Languages Skills

• Excellent written and oral French and English skills are essential, any other language is an advantage

We are hiring an Executive Assistant to work directly with the Executive Committee.

This is a high-responsibility and high-exposure role, requiring discretion, precision, strong organizational skills, and the ability to operate in a fast-paced executive environment where priorities can shift quickly.
More than a traditional Executive Assistant role, this position combines first-class executive support with the ability to prepare high-quality materials, coordinate complex topics, and ensure effective follow-up on key priorities. You will play a central role in helping the Executives to stay organized, fully briefed, and focused on the most important matters.
This role requires exceptional organizational skills and the ability to support multiple senior stakeholders, often with competing priorities, while maintaining the highest levels of professionalism, responsiveness, and discretion.
This is a unique opportunity for a motivated and ambitious professional looking to accelerate their development, gain close exposure to executive leadership and governance, and build a long-term career within a demanding and dynamic environment.

Your next challenge:

1. Executive Support & Prioritization

• Manage complex calendars with a high degree of autonomy, acting as a proactive gatekeeper of time, priorities, and commitments.
• Coordinate internal and external meetings, Board-related interactions, conference calls, and video conferences.
• Anticipate upcoming deadlines, priorities, and key meetings to ensure executives are fully prepared.
• Prepare agendas, logistics, briefing material, and relevant documentation ahead of meetings.
• Support multiple senior stakeholders simultaneously, balancing competing priorities while maintaining a high level of service and responsiveness.

2. Communication & Inbox Management

• Act as a trusted point of contact for internal and external stakeholders, ensuring smooth and professional communication.

• Support the preparation and maintenance of Excel trackers, reports, and follow-up documents.

4. Travel, Expenses & Administrative Excellence

• Coordinate domestic and international travel, ensuring efficiency, accuracy, and cost awareness.

Your mission

A career in our Valuation & Modelling Services practice will provide you with the opportunity to work at the forefront of valuation, financial modelling, and investment analysis across private markets.

As part of the largest and most qualified dedicated valuation and modelling team in Luxembourg, you will advise leading alternative investment managers, institutional investors, infrastructure funds, private equity sponsors, family offices, sovereign wealth funds, and multinational corporations on complex valuation and modelling matters throughout the investment lifecycle.
Recognised as a centre of excellence for portfolio valuation, our team delivers independent valuations and reviews of investment portfolios, businesses, complex securities, financial instruments, and intangible assets to support financial and investor reporting, regulatory compliance, governance, and strategic decision-making.

Our team also works closely with PwC Luxembourg's market-leading Assurance practice, supporting a broad range of valuation matters across audit engagements. This provides our professionals with unique exposure to valuation challenges across multiple asset classes, investment structures, and industries, while helping maintain the highest standards of quality, consistency, and professional rigour.

title: Senior Tax advisor (h/f)
description:
Senior Tax advisor (H/F)

General Information
Ref # BGL_TaxAdvisor
Hot job Yes
City Luxembourg
Contract type Permanent
Professional family F24 - TAX
Recruiter FONTAINE, CATHERINE

Description & Requirements

BGL BNP Paribas est une des plus grandes banques du Grand-Duché de Luxembourg et fait partie du Groupe BNP Paribas.

Elle propose à ses clients particuliers, professionnels, entreprises et de banque privée une gamme particulièrement large de produits financiers et de solutions de bancassurance.

En 2024, BGL BNP Paribas a été désignée « Best Bank in Luxembourg » par Euromoney et a obtenu en 2025, pour la 10è année consécutive, la certification « Top Employer Luxembourg », saluant l'excellence des conditions de travail offertes à ses collaborateurs.

Senior Tax advisor (H/F)
  
CONTEXTE ET ENJEUX

Vous rejoindrez, en tant que « Senior Tax advisor », la Fonction des « Affaires fiscales » de BGL BNP Paribas.  

Vous participez ainsi activement à la réalisation des missions des Affaires Fiscales qui consistent notamment

• à assurer la maitrise du risque fiscal pour l'ensemble des opérations réalisées par le groupe BNP sur le territoire de Luxembourg et
• à contribuer à la maitrise de la charge fiscale du groupe BNP sur le même territoire.
  
CONCRÈTEMENT, VOTRE MISSION ET VOTRE QUOTIDIEN ?

Dans le cadre de vos fonctions, vous êtes amené à exercer les activités suivantes :

• Analyser et sécuriser, sur le plan fiscal, les opérations et produits mis en place par les métiers et entités du Groupe au Luxembourg et proposer des solutions alternatives pour répondre aux risques et contraintes identifiés.
• Apporter son expertise fiscale pour toutes opérations à dimension transfrontière de la banque ou des entités du Groupe au Luxembourg.
• Contribuer à la maitrise de la charge fiscale de la banque et des entités du Groupe au Luxembourg et revoir leurs déclarations fiscales.
• Assurer la liaison entre les métiers ou entités et les conseillers fiscaux externes (avocats, cabinets d'audit).
• Suivre les évolutions réglementaires fiscales en matière de fiscalité luxembourgeoise, européenne et internationale (OCDE) et analyser les implications pour la banque et les entités du Groupe au Luxembourg.
• Assurer une formation régulière sur les sujets fiscaux d'actualités.
• Assurer le suivi et participer à la validation des procédures internes de la banque comportant des aspects fiscaux.
  
LES MISSIONS C'EST IMPORTANT, L'ÉQUIPE ET L'ENVIRONNEMENT DE TRAVAIL AUSSI !

Votre environnement de travail

- Vous ferez partie d'une équipe de 10 personnes avec laquelle vous travaillerez de manière rapprochée.
- Vous serez également amené(e) à interagir avec de nombreux interlocuteurs au sein de la Banque et des autres entités du territoire.
- Le poste est éligible au télétravail et au travail sur sites distants suivant les règles habituelles observées dans la Banque.
- Sur ce poste, le souhait premier est de recruter un collaborateur à temps plein mais des aménagements pourront être envisagés en fonction des besoins spécifiques de la personne recrutée.

Les apports de ce poste ?

Vous disposerez d'un large panel d'intervention dans les divers domaines d'activités de la banque au Luxembourg et ceci notamment en accompagnant les métiers/ fonctions/ entités du groupe dans leurs transactions locales ou transfrontières.
Votre rôle vous emmènera également sur des projets de plus grande envergure comme des fusions-acquisitions, opérations de leasing financier, accompagnement des entreprises en local ou encore des projets de développement durable.
  
ÊTES-VOUS NOTRE FUTUR(E) Senior Tax Advisor

Expérience professionnelle et/ou diplôme
Etude:  Diplôme de Master à orientation Droit / Economie / Ecole de commerce
Expérience Professionnelle : Vous avez une première expérience de 7 ans minimum en fiscalité luxembourgeoise et internationale des sociétés et vous souhaitez mettre à disposition vos connaissances acquises au service des métiers de la banque.

Compétences comportementales

• Proactivité
• Capacité à collaborer / travail d'équipe
• Capacité à communiquer - à l'oral et par écrit
• Créativité & Innovation / Capacité à résoudre des problèmes
• Capacité à synthétiser / simplifier
• Rigueur

Compétences transversales

• Capacité à élaborer et à adapter un processus
• Capacité à comprendre, expliquer et conduire le changement
• Capacité à établir et activer des réseaux
• Capacité d'analyse
• Capacité à anticiper les évolutions métiers / stratégiques
• Capacité à animer une réunion, un séminaire, un comité, une formation…

Compétences techniques

Vous disposez de compétences en fiscalité luxembourgeoise et internationale des sociétés et en comptabilité.

Connaissances linguistiques

Vous maitrisez couramment le français et l'anglais.  La pratique d'une autre langue comme le luxembourgeois ou l'allemand est considérée comme un atout supplémentaire.

Dans le cadre de la finalisation du processus de recrutement, il sera demandé au candidat présélectionné un extrait de casier judiciaire datant de moins de 3 mois (bulletin n°3 pour le Grand-Duché de Luxembourg), conformément aux dispositions de la loi du 23 juillet 2016 relative au casier judiciaire, compte tenu du domaine d'activité de notre établissement.

La diversité, l'équité et l'inclusion sont des valeurs clés pour le bien-être et la performance des équipes. Nous souhaitons accueillir et fidéliser tous nos collaborateurs sans distinction : c'est ainsi que nous construirons, ensemble, la finance de demain, innovante, responsable et durable.

title: AML Compliance Analyst (m/f)
description:
2026-1226 AML Compliance Analyst (H/F)

Description du poste

Pays Luxembourg
Lieu Luxembourg-ville
Fonction Tous les métiers de la banque - Compliance
Intitulé du poste AML Compliance Analyst (H/F)
Type de contrat CDI
Temps de travail Temps plein

Activités / Missions

Présente au Luxembourg depuis plus de 100 ans, la Banque de Luxembourg est un acteur financier incontournable de la place au service de clients privés, des entreprises luxembourgeoises et de clients professionnels issus des métiers de la gestion d'actifs. Certifiée B Corp depuis 2023, notre Banque s'engage à renforcer l'impact social, sociétal et environnemental de ses activités.

Mission

Au sein de notre équipe Compliance, l'équipe Compliance-AML participe à la mise en œuvre de la politique AML/FT et à la vérification de son respect au sein de la Banque de Luxembourg, de sa filiale et de sa succursale.

En tant que AML Compliance Analyst, votre rôle consiste à gérer le volet opérationnel de la lutte AML/FT au quotidien dans l'analyse et la gestion des risques liés à la lutte contre le blanchiment d'argent et le financement du terrorisme mais également à conseiller et à guider nos conseiller·es en la matière.

Analyse et gestion des risques AML/FT

• Vous guidez et assistez les conseillers en matière de lutte contre le blanchiment et le financement du terrorisme avec pédagogie.
• Vous êtes garant de la mise en œuvre de la politique AML/FT au sein de la Banque ;
• Vous prenez en charge l'analyse des dossiers clients Asset Servicing (fonds d'investissement et institutionnels) mais également Banque Privée / Entreprises et en vérifiez leur conformité ;
• Vous êtes le relais compliance au sein de la Banque, et participez à la sensibilisation du personnel ;
• Vous êtes un des interlocuteurs des autorités règlementaires (CSSF, Parquet, CRF…) ;

Amélioration des flux et des solutions

• Vous êtes force de proposition et participez à différents projets en lien avec la conformité au sein de la Banque ;
• En tant que conseiller et expert AML, vous soutenez les équipes projets dans la définition des besoins de l'équipe quant aux solutions IT à implémenter et développer ;
• Vous participez au design du modèle de gestion AML au sein de la banque entre les différentes équipes Client Data Management, les équipes commerciales et le département Compliance ;

Profil

Doté d'une riche expérience dans une fonction similaire, vous souhaitez valoriser vos connaissances auprès d'une nouvelle structure qui vous permettra de mettre à profit votre expertise et de participer au projet de développement de la gestion AML/FT au sein de la banque.

• Vous êtes (f/h) titulaire d'un Master en droit et/ou sciences économiques/financières ;
• Vous bénéficiez d'une expérience de 3 à 5 ans dans une fonction compliance AML idéalement au sein d'un cabinet de conseil / Big 4 ou d'un grand organisme financier ;
• Vous avez une très bonne connaissance des règlementations AML/KYC et des risques y associés idéalement dans le domaine de l'Asset Servicing mais également de la Banque Privée (activité majeure);
• Vous êtes doté d'excellentes capacités d'analyse et de synthèse ainsi que d'une grande rigueur ;
• Vous faites preuve d'une grande aisance relationnelle et rédactionnelle ;
• Vous êtes proactif, faites preuve d'esprit d'initiative et participez à l'amélioration des flux pour une meilleure efficacité au sein de l'équipe ;
• Vous êtes titulaire du M1 Compliance. Le M2 et M3 constitue un atout.
• La connaissance du système bancaire AVALOQ est un plus.
• Vous maîtrisez le français et l'anglais. La pratique de l'allemand constitue un avantage.

Convaincus que notre diversité fait notre force, nous sommes signataires de la Charte de la Diversité, Lëtzebuerg. Attentifs à l'égalité des chances, nous nous engageons à travers des actions concrètes, notamment en faveur des jeunes talents, des femmes, des collaborateurs seniors…

Vous souhaitez …

• rejoindre des équipes composées de femmes et d'hommes d'horizons multiples, aux parcours et compétences complémentaires,
• vous développer dans un cadre de travail respectant l'équilibre vie privée-vie professionnelle ;
• évoluer dans un environnement propice à l'épanouissement de tous les talents…

Vous vous reconnaissez dans cette description et souhaitez nous rejoindre ?
N'attendez plus et adressez-nous votre CV accompagné d'une lettre de motivation via notre Espace Candidats, nous serons ravis d'échanger avec vous !

Avant la conclusion du contrat de travail, un extrait du casier judiciaire (bulletin n°3), datant de moins de 2 mois, vous sera demandé, uniquement à titre de consultation, afin de garantir votre honorabilité au regard de la fonction à pourvoir.


Critères candidat

Niveau d'études requis BAC + 5
Expérience requise 3 à 5 ans et plus

title: Transfer Agent (f/m/d)
description:
Transfer Agent

Locations DNU Luxembourg
Time type Full time
Job requisition id JR-0024160

The Apex Group was established in Bermuda in 2003 and is now one of the world's largest fund administration and middle office solutions providers.

Our business is unique in its ability to reach globally, service locally and provide cross-jurisdictional services. With our clients at the heart of everything we do, our hard-working team has successfully delivered on an unprecedented growth and transformation journey, and we are now represented by over circa 13,000 employees across 112 offices worldwide.Your career with us should reflect your energy and passion.
That's why, at Apex Group, we will do more than simply ‘empower' you. We will work to supercharge your unique skills and experience.
Take the lead and we'll give you the support you need to be at the top of your game. And we offer you the freedom to be a positive disrupter and turn big ideas into bold, industry-changing realities.

For our business, for clients, and for you

We're currently looking for a Transfer Agent to support our growing operations in the Transfer Agency department. This is a permanent role based in Luxembourg and comes with a favorable salary and benefits package.

Job Specification:

The principal objective of this first line of defense position is driving the strategic direction of the TA Operations Team and the control framework within which the firm should operate.

TA Operations team primary task is to maintain the client fund's registers up-to-date in accordance with the current regulatory requirements in Luxembourg, alongside Apex Group as well as Apex Funds Services S.A, policies, and procedures.  
Main responsibilities from the team will include investors on boarding, processing of subscriptions / redemptions / switches / transfers of shares, cash settlement, cash reconciliation and reporting (investors & clients).    
The TA Operations employee contributes to the day day-to-day tasks of the TA Operations team within Transfer Agency Operations for our Luxembourg clients and act as an escalation point for more junior Team Members as well as performing specific client tasks. This role requires good regulatory knowledge and an appreciation of operational best practice.

Service Delivery Performance

• Maintain an effective control & oversight of assigned TA Operation tasks.
• Interact with Team Managers on governance-related matters, propose solutions, in case of escalations;
• Take ownership where necessary on complex cases and / or analyse, consult with line management and compliance as required;
• Creation and maintenance of accurate Fund static data within TA systems.
• Receipt, execution and settlement of investor's trade instructions for open funds.
• Calculation of allocations & distributions for open ended funds
• Preparation of distribution packs
• Transaction reporting to clients, investors and fund management stakeholders
• Cash processing (receipts/payments) and bank accounts reconciliation
• Oversight of offshored activities
• Assist the Team Manager and be the contact person for Clients and Investors for operational issues
• Assist internal / external audit as required;
• Ensure a first-time right approach aiming at zero error recorded as a consequence of a failure of our controls (maker/checker) or any particular omission;
• Make every effort to ensure a zero Client or Investor complaint approach, by way of effective and efficient communication, respect of business etiquette and professional interaction with all stakeholders;
• Ensure terms of SLAs, where applicable, are adhered to and updated regularly for each Client;
• Assist with completion of KPIs and MIs is maintained up to date for the assigned Clients-Investors' base;
• Interact where appropriate with the outsourcing offices and maintain efficient communication and quality control over activities performed offshore.
• Paxus Knowledge is an advantage

Governance

• Develop strong working relationships with Clients,  shareholders, regulators, auditors and other external and internal parties as required;
• Assist Team Managers in explaining operational requirements to clients and investors;
• Use appropriate tact and diplomacy when exchanging complex or sensitive information with internal or external stakeholders;
• Participate in any audit-related exercises (Internal/External audit, QA etc) as required by ensure all documentary evidence is provided and any query from Auditors is answered in time to prevent cost overruns;
• Contribute to the success of due diligence visits and annual due diligence reviews by clients;
• Participate in investors and/or client calls to discuss performance & strategy, troubleshoot, ease onboarding or migration of funds
• Perform function in line with the department procedure and Apex policies in respect of the regulatory framework, the internal procedures, guidelines, and code of conduct.
Human Resources:
• Ensure adherence to our corporate values, lead by example and apply relevant conduct/behaviour in everything we do;
• Manage capacity in an efficient and proactive manner, ensure coverage is aligned with applicable requirements (backups, lunchtime, WFH);
• Ensure that TA Ops teams objectives and processes are aligned with larger strategic initiatives.
• Ensure mandatory trainings are completed on time.

Projects:

• Contribute specific ad-hoc projects and supervise delivery and completion;

Personal Objectives

• Ensure you use the relevant internal and external resources to enhance knowledge and capabilities required for the role.

Please note that a background check will be conducted as part of the hiring process once a job offer has been made. In accordance with the provisions of the Luxembourg law of 23 July 2016 amending the law of 29 March 2013, candidates may be required to provide an extract from their criminal record. This document, issued by the authorities, must not be older than three months. Such a document will be requested with the aim of carrying out a character check on candidates, bearing in mind the area of activity of our establishment and, more particularly, the tasks described in the job description.

Amazon is seeking an analytical and resourceful Financial Analyst (FA) to support our fast growing network. • Handle sensitive information with maturity, tact, and sound judgement.
• Build trusted working relationships with senior stakeholders across the bank.
• Remain calm, structured, and solution-oriented in situations of pressure or ambiguity.

• Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Management - or equivalent.

This is a new workstream where you will have the opportunity to innovate and deliver at scale.
These defects often do not reside within a single operations business line but span multiple functions, including first mile (FC), middle mile (ATS), last mile (AMZL, Carrier) and Reverse logistics. You will work closely with senior leaders to influence decision-making and guide them to focus on high-impact areas by creating clear business cases that consider trade-offs.

Key job responsibilities

- Own the goal of reducing DPMO and costs for the "not delivered – not returned" metrics across EU Amazon.
- Responsible for the operating planning (OP1/OP2) cycles for the program.
- Deliver OP2 savings through initiatives that impact this goal.
- Dive Deep into data to identify the biggest operational opportunities in a new area with a lot of ambiguity.
- Actively seek operational improvement opportunities to ensure items are safely returned to the FC in good condition if they are not delivered.
- Develop and guide team members to focus on the most impactful areas of opportunity.
- Identify trends and take ownership to solve problems. Escalate any delays in timely manner which puts deliverables at risks.
- Support teams (FC, AMZL, GTS, ATS, Relo FC) in prioritizing initiatives to create an end-to-end secure network.
- Lead WBR, MBR, and QBR with end-to-end senior stakeholders (including L8, L10).

You will manage a team of Program Managers and technical team members who will collaborate with various tech, operations, and business stakeholders to drive business-critical programs. You'll challenge and guide the team to ensure timely progress and the completion of their deliverables, coordinate their efforts, and address any lack of traction or adoption where necessary.
You will take ownership of the goal, stay focused on delivering the roadmap, and regularly review milestones. Lead discussion with finance partners to ensure savings glidepaths are met. The team runs EU-wide initiatives aimed at improving the customer experience by identifying, analysing, and resolving operational defects in the First (FCs), Middle (ATS), Last-mile (Carriers and AMZL), and Transportation networks. The products developed by the team are rolled out across the EU Amazon Fulfilment network. As our tools have become the standard in the EU, some have already been adopted by global stakeholders.

(1) integrate new Amazon organization van requirements (e.g. Ship With Amazon (SWA) /Delivery Service Partner (DSP) Lite);
(2) move to clustering, probability-based modelling and agentic AI;
(3) scale optimization models with objective function being the operational costs;
(4) evolve the user interface from Excel based to a more friendly dashboard;
(5) integrate new supply channels and netting logics within the model (e.g. van sharing, off-season vans, vehicle multi use etc.) to drive the related sourcing accordingly;
(6) integrate seamless both upstream and downstream (approvals) processes.
(7) scale Fleet Requirement Planning to Middle Mile
(8) supporting effectively critical business decisions (Capex/Opex, rental/lease/cross country transfer, vehicle type mix, asset utilization etc.) based on risk assessment and long term constraints. Visibility will be key for the success of the program.

For this purpose you will develop a “digital twin” of the FRP models where to perform “what if analysis”, multiple planning scenarios and investment analysis to define “alternative” demand and supply plans, in collaboration with Finance and other Stakeholder teams.

A day in the life

• Design and develop scalable Fleet demand modelling;
• Integrate closely with finance business partners to ensure plans are efficient and meet Peak demand, to ensure efficient ordering process
• Define and own Fleet Demand forecasting accuracy metric
• Be accountable for the timely “buy in” from VP/Senior Stakeholder about the significant Fleet CAPEX investment and OPEX decisions;
• Consolidate input from a different set of stakeholders and ensure fleet plans always consume the latest available assumptions;
• Drive the transition to electrification (EV planning Business As Usual) and integration of MoT into Fleet Requirement Planning;
• Extend FRP process to new business customer organization (SWA, DSP Lite) and countries to be launched over the next years;

About the team

The EU Amazon Logistics (AMZL) Fleet Planning & Analytics team operates within Global Fleet & Products. We're responsible for EU AMZL fleet requirement definition to source Armada/Rentals, short-term deployment scheduling, and business intelligence support—with the north star to scale fleet capacity efficiently

The Fleet Demand planners within FPA team, are comparable to other companies' “Demand Planner” profiles, but facing the peculiar challenges to integrate upstream planning cycles, e.g. from SCOT/Top Line to LTP/TL disaggregation, from MRP to DA Labour Plan (LPT) and DSP diversification planning, to create demand plans for diesel (ICE), Electric Vehicles (EV), Long/Short Wheel Base (LWB/SWB) vans requirements across Europe for long (+3y) and medium term (<12m) planning, and driving the resulting order plans and work with Finance, OEM business development, Rental procurement to ensure plans are executed effectively and efficiently.

title: Fleet Data Manager (Fixed-term contract) (m/f)
description:
Fleet Data Manager (Fixed-term contract)
Job ID: 10488292 | Amazon EU Sarl - A84
Description
Amazon's Fleet Procurement and Capacity Planning (FPAC) team manages a large-scale international commercial vehicle fleet across 10 European markets. This fleet depends on accurate, timely data flowing between two Fleet Management Companies (FMCs), Amazon's internal planning systems, and multiple cross-functional stakeholders.

This role owns the operational delivery and quality of all fleet data provided by FMCs (Ayvens and Arval) to Amazon. You will be the single-threaded owner ensuring that vehicle lifecycle data (from order placement through deployment, maintenance, defleeting, and remarketing) is delivered per contractual SLAs, meets validation standards, and flows reliably into the planning tools and reporting mechanisms that drive fleet capacity decisions.

This is a hands-on data operations and vendor management role. You will spend the majority of your time ensuring data reliability, resolving reporting failures with FMC technical contacts, and supporting the internal teams who depend on this data to make procurement and capacity decisions worth hundreds of millions in OPEX annually.

Please note that this is a 12 months fixed-term contract.

Key job responsibilities

1- Maintain Fleet Data Reliability

- Own the end-to-end data delivery relationship with Ayvens and Arval technical points of contact, ensuring reporting against established SLAs and contractual obligations
- Monitor, triage, and resolve data quality issues across SDR (Supply Delivery Reporting) and SRR (Supply Return Reporting) pipelines, including idle stock positions at VIN level
- Support Weekly Business Reviews and Variable Last Mile Rentals reporting cadences by ensuring upstream data is accurate and delivered on time
- Escalate systemic data failures through the appropriate FMC governance channels (Monthly Business Reviews, performance reviews).

2- Enable Planning Tools and Downstream Consumers

- Ensure data feeds into FORCE (Fleet Optimization, Requirement and Control Engine) and FAB (Fleet Allocation and Balancing) meet signal integration requirements
- Partner with the MAPS team (Mid-Term Planning) and Fleet Planning to resolve data gaps that block planning accuracy and automation
- Triage new data requests from internal stakeholders against existing data specifications; eliminate redundancy before placing additional requirements on FMCs

3- Drive Continuous Improvement

- Identify and implement process improvements to reduce manual data reconciliation effort
- Develop monitoring mechanisms to proactively flag reporting inaccuracies before they propagate into planning decisions
- Document and maintain the fleet data catalogue, including ownership, refresh cadences, quality thresholds, and known limitations
- Ensure any new fleet programs (LMR expansion, new country launches, Middle Mile integration) include data requirements in vendor agreements from the outset

4- Cross-Functional Coordination

- Align with Fleet Partnerships (FMC contractual owners), Fleet Deployment & Redeployment, Planning, and GFPA (Global Fleet Planning Analytics) on data priorities and dependencies
- Influence FMC behavior through performance metrics and contractual accountability rather than direct authority
- Represent data requirements in FMC governance forums (MBR/QBR)

A day in the life

Basic Qualifications

- Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Math, Business, Supply Chain or other related quantitative discipline
- Experience working with data analytics and using these metrics to identify problems, or experience in an operational role
- Experience in vendor management, or experience in operations and on-call support for data center facilities, mission critical plants, or production facilities
- Experience working directly with business stakeholders to translate between data and business needs
- Experience performing data analysis and troubleshooting data integrity issues
- Experience completing complex tasks quickly with little to no guidance and react with appropriate urgency to situations that require a quick turnaround, or experience in an operational role

Preferred Qualifications

- Experience in transportation or supply chain within a high-volume logistics, manufacturing or engineering environment
- Experience working within a global company, with multi-country responsibilities
- Experience in procurement, inventory and asset management of IT equipment as well as IT lifecycle
- Experience managing data pipelines
- Experience with machine learning/statistical modeling data analysis tools and techniques, and parameters that affect their performance

title: Solution Architect I - Subsidy Projects (fixed-term 24 months) (m/f)
description:
Description des tâches:


Who we are

Luxembourg National Data Service (LNDS) is a brand of PNED G.I.E. an organisation created by the Luxembourg Government, to implement Luxembourg's strategies in research, innovation, and digitalisation.
LNDS enables value creation from secondary use of data, for public and private partners and supports the sharing and re-use of public sector data, in a trustable manner.
The LNDS service portfolio includes know-how, capabilities, tools, infrastructure, and data services.
Through efficient & responsible use of data and improving the secondary use of data, LNDS will support the acceleration of economic, ecological, and societal transitions.
www.lnds.lu | LNDS on LinkedIn


Purpose of the job / project

Help design and deliver the data infrastructure that Luxembourg and its European partners rely on for secure, lawful access to sensitive data. You will work alongside senior architects on real systems with real deadlines and take on your own architectural scope as you go.

This is a fixed-term position of 24 months, created to meet a sustained increase in architecture work across our EU project portfolio.
You will work on one or more projects from that portfolio — currently including STORE-1PLUSMG, USE-1PLUSMG, SCAILED, the European Compliance Stack, DDSSC2, COOPAIFA and PANDAI — with assignments set by portfolio priorities and evolving as projects start and close.
We are looking for a Solution Architect to help design and deliver secure, large-scale data infrastructure, working alongside our senior architects.
You will consolidate functional and non-functional requirements from data providers and partner organisations and translate them into architecture documentation.
You will contribute to the specification, configuration, integration, and technical validation of the components behind our data services.
Working with community frameworks such as Gaia-X, IDSA and DSSC, you will help build the data solutions our partners across Europe depend on.


What you will do

Architecture design and documentation

Learn and deliver the core architecture artefacts, starting from established LNDS patterns and templates, and taking on more of the design work as your experience grows.
Maintain the architecture documentation set across assigned projects — keeping it current, internally consistent and ready for formal review. Several projects require successive versioned releases approved at fixed milestones.

Requirements and analysis

Support senior architects in gathering and documenting functional and non-functional requirements from data providers, partner organisations and internal stakeholders.
Analyse and document business constraints.

Implementation support

Work with engineering and operations colleagues to turn architecture into working systems.
Support the specification, configuration, and integration of components.
Support technical validation and acceptance activities, including preparing test scenarios and evidence.

Standards, compliance and quality

Learn, adopt and apply LNDS architectural standards, patterns and review practices consistently, and flag where they do not fit.
Support the implementation of technical and organisational measures under Data Protection by Design and Default, working with Legal and data governance colleagues.

Project and consortium contribution

Contribute to project deliverables and milestones, tracking your own commitments and raising slippage early.
Support proposal preparation with technical input and effort estimation.


Who you are

BSc or MSc in a scientific, technological or engineering discipline related to computer science, information technology or computing.
1-2 years working explicitly as a solution or enterprise architect on large-scale or federated data systems.
Working knowledge of distributed systems, APIs and integration patterns, databases, and data modelling.
Exposure with cloud or container platforms, infrastructure-as-code, and CI/CD pipelines.
Foundational understanding of information security, authentication and authorisation, encryption, and network segmentation.
Able to write clear technical documentation and produce readable diagrams.
Awareness of GDPR and the broader EU data regulatory landscape.
Familiarity with agile delivery practices.
Excellent communication skills in English.
Working knowledge of one of Luxembourg's official languages (French, German or Luxembourgish) is a plus.
Curious, methodical, and comfortable speaking when you do not understand something.
Willingness to learn architectural concepts and methods, and to develop your information security and regulatory knowledge seriously.
Collaborative, adaptable, and able to work effectively in a cross-functional and multicultural environment.
Interest in health data, genomics, data spaces or public sector data infrastructure.
Prior experience in EU-funded projects is a plus.


About us

What we offer

Dynamic and innovative work environment
Collaboration with diverse stakeholders
Inclusive and diverse culture
European recognition and impactful projects
Shape the future of the data revolution


What sets us apart

The Luxembourg National Data Service is a modern and dynamic undertaking.
We embrace a Lean and Agile mindset, combining the entrepreneurial spirit of a startup with the responsibility of a public body on a national mission.
We will be a partner of society and industry, collaborating with a hugely diverse group of stakeholders in public research, public authorities, European institutions, academic and private institutions, and small, medium and large companies.
Therefore, we have an international and multilingual character.
Even in this rather ambitious context, we preserve a warm and personal atmosphere.
Inclusion and diversity are some of our key values.
We ensure that everyone has employment and career opportunities in accordance with their skills and aspirations, respecting and being mindful of their individual characteristics.
Join LNDS and revolutionise the data economy!
Be part of our dynamic team driving innovation and making a tangible impact.
Collaborate on cutting-edge projects, gaining European recognition in the prestigious European Data Spaces initiative.
Shape a transformative future in the data revolution.

Experience in EU-funded projects: work package or task leadership, deliverable ownership, consortium working is an advantage.
Excellent communication skills in English. Working knowledge of one of Luxembourg's official languages (French, German or Luxembourgish) is a plus.


About us

European recognition and impactful projects

description:

Description

The Medical Accommodations Global Relations & Strategy Specialist is a specialized individual contributor role within Global Medical Accommodations (GMA), created to align ROW stakeholders to our global strategy, ways of working, and technology direction - while ensuring their legitimate concerns are heard, addressed, or escalated decisively. A key objective of this role is to help GMA progress toward global parity between the US and all other regions, ensuring ROW associates and business partners receive a consistent, high-quality accommodations experience.

This role operates as a strategic stakeholder advocate and internal change agent - listening deeply to regional business concerns, evangelizing the global accommodations mission, having backbone when stakeholder requests conflict with global strategy, and bridging divides where local legal requirements demand differentiation. The specialist owns the overarching program direction and strategy for ROW stakeholder alignment, but executes through partnership with the Global Parity & People Accessibility Leader, SME/ACES teams, Technology, and others as required.

Key job responsibilities

Stakeholder Advocacy & Strategic Alignment

Serve as the primary point of alignment between ROW stakeholders and GAA's global strategy, building deep understanding of regional business concerns while driving adoption of global ways of working and technology direction.
Evangelize the global accommodations mission and technology strategy to ROW stakeholders, building understanding and buy-in for the direction even when it challenges local preferences or established practices.
Exercise backbone: where stakeholder concerns conflict with global strategy and are not legally required, push back respectfully, bring stakeholders on board with the rationale, or escalate with a clear recommendation.
Where stakeholder concerns are valid - aligned to global policy or driven by local legal requirements - identify gaps and partner with the Global Parity & People Accessibility Leader to ensure they are addressed through the Global Parity program or technology roadmap.
Identify and surface emerging stakeholder concerns proactively (e.g., self-service models driving unintended volume in EU markets, insufficient medical documentation friction creating compliance risk), working with relevant teams to close gaps before they escalate.
Treat stakeholders as customers: understand their needs, close the loop on their concerns, and drive accountability for resolution.
Propose and implement mechanisms to measure stakeholder satisfaction - addressing the current gap where manager and business partner experience with accommodation services is not systematically captured.
Provide structured, data-backed updates to stakeholders on initiatives and concerns they have raised - keeping them informed, engaged, building trust through transparency and follow-through.

Service Adoption & Awareness

Develop and drive a global strategy to increase adoption of GMA services across ROW countries.
Partner with country operations and HR teams to understand barriers to service utilization, and work with relevant teams to remove friction and increase awareness.
Track adoption metrics by country and region, surfacing gaps and recommending targeted interventions to close them.

Program Ownership & Cross-Functional Execution

Own the overarching ROW stakeholder alignment program and strategic direction, executing through partnership with the Global Parity & People Accessibility Leader, SME/ACES, Ops Center of Excellence, business policy/standard work teams, Technology, Legal, and Expansions.
Partner with the Global Parity & People Accessibility Leader to ensure ROW stakeholder needs inform parity priorities. Validate that parity deliverables address field concerns and drive stakeholder adoption of implemented solutions. This role does not own the Global Parity program - it serves as the voice of ROW stakeholders into that program.
Identify ROW-specific technology needs and partner with the Global Parity & People Accessibility Leader to ensure these are reflected in the technology roadmap and product requirements.
Facilitate cross-functional working groups and governance forums, establishing clear decision rights, escalation pathways, and accountability mechanisms across all stakeholder teams.

Process Improvement and Standardization

Conduct structured current-state analyses and future-state mapping, engaging cross-functional teams to validate findings and build alignment on solutions before scaling.
Facilitate process improvement initiatives across ROW regions, identifying fragmentation and inconsistency in accommodation workflows and partnering with the Global Parity & People Accessibility Leader and operational teams to drive resolution.
Monitor regional performance against defined GMA expectations and metrics that are important to the business - including new metrics where existing measures do not capture stakeholder or operational reality.

Senior Leadership Engagement & Escalation Management

Build and maintain productive relationships with senior leaders across Operations, PXT, Legal, and WHS - ensuring they are informed, engaged, and aligned on accommodation strategy for their regions.

Draft and deliver structured communications, leadership briefings, and status updates that are concise, data-backed, and appropriate for executive audiences, including contributions to the business's Weekly Business Review (WBR) and Monthly Business Review (MBR) mechanisms as required.

Proactively surface cross-regional risks with proposed mitigation plans.
Exercise sound judgment in identifying when complex issues require escalation, preparing clear, data-driven problem statements, root cause analyses, and recommended actions that enable leaders to make informed decisions quickly.

Data Analysis and Insights

Analyze case data, audit findings, stakeholder feedback, and operational metrics across ROW regions to identify trends, bottlenecks, and emerging issues before they escalate into systemic problems.
Build and maintain tracking mechanisms that provide visibility into case volumes, turnaround times, adjustment types, stakeholder satisfaction, service adoption rates, and compliance adherence across the ROW network.
Use data to prioritize program initiatives, measure the impact of implemented solutions, and communicate progress to stakeholders and leadership.

Quantify the impact of stakeholder-raised concerns (e.g., volume increases attributable to self-service rollout) to inform strategic decisions on technology deployment pace and sequencing.

Regional Expansion and Change Management

Partner with the Expansions team during active country launches, focusing on post-launch adoption and ongoing stakeholder alignment rather than launch execution.
Lead change management for stakeholder adoption of GMA services and strategic initiatives this role drives, including stakeholder communications, training development, and feedback loop mechanisms that ensure adoption and continuous refinement.
Document learnings from ROW implementations and contribute to a central knowledge base that enables teams to benefit from cross-regional experience and avoid duplicating effort.

- Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Healthcare Management, or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

description:
Vi søger en dygtig kundeservicemedarbejder til vores kontor i Gzira, Malta med opstart hurtigst muligt. Din primære opgave bliver at besvare indkomne skriftlige henvendelser fra vores kunder via e-mail og chat. Vores mål er at sikre, at alle kunder modtager professionel vejledning og den bedst mulige service. Der vil desuden være mulighed for at få flere ansvarsområder i takt med dine præstationer og kompetencer.

Som kundeservicemedarbejder er service din vigtigste opgave. Du skal have lyst til at formulere dig skriftligt, være løsningsorienteret og brænde for at yde en fremragende kundeoplevelse. Ingen opgave er for stor eller for lille, når det handler om at hjælpe vores kunder.

Dine opgaver:

  • Besvare kundeforespørgsler via e-mail og chat.

  • Sikre, at komplekse kundehenvendelser bliver løst hurtigt og tilfredsstillende.

  • Yde teknisk support og vejledning om spil.

  • Overvåge hjemmesidens tilgængelighed og funktionalitet samt rapportere fejl og problemer.

  • Deltage i test af nye produkter og tjenester.

  • Medvirke til at promovere nye produkter og kampagner.

  • Bidrage til andre arbejdsopgaver i virksomheden efter behov.

Vi forestiller os, at du:

  • Er serviceorienteret, udadvendt, hjælpsom og imødekommende.

  • Har fremragende skriftlige danskkundskaber og gode engelskkundskaber.

  • Er ansvarsbevidst og motiveret for at nå interne mål.

  • Arbejder struktureret og har sans for detaljer.

  • Har erfaring med digitale arbejdsopgaver – det er en fordel, men ikke et krav.

Vi tilbyder:

  • Gode muligheder for udvikling og ansvar

  • Danske kollegaer med et danske chefer

  • Sociale arrangementer

  • Hjælp med praktiske ting ved flytning til Malta

  • 150 euro til flybillet

  • Relocationpakke, så du kommer godt fra start med bolig

Stillingen er på fuld tid og omfatter vagter alle ugens syv dage, fordelt på fem ugentlige vagter inden for tidsrummet kl. 08.00–21.00.

Lokation: Gzira, Malta. Løn efter kvalifikationer.

Har du spørgsmål til stillingen, er du velkommen til at kontakte os.

title: Programmatic and Marketing Tech Manager - Malta
description:
Come and join our journey!

At Immense Group, we are guided by our core values of passion, boldness, and integrity. We strive to create an environment where our people thrive, driven by a love for innovation and a commitment to delivering exceptional player experiences. If you’re passionate about marketing, we’d love for you to join our team as a Programmatic and Marketing Tech Manager. This is an exciting opportunity for a professional looking to make a significant impact in a fast-paced and collaborative environment.

A taste of what you’ll do

The Programmatic and Marketing Tech Manager is responsible for the set-up, management, optimization and analyzing performance campaigns in specific regions.

Accountabilities:

    Campaign Optimization & Innovation: Lead the ongoing optimization of media campaigns, utilizing data-driven insights to refine strategies and identify new growth opportunities. Actively test and innovate to ensure sustained campaign performance across digital channels.
    Cross-Functional Collaboration: Collaborate closely with internal teams (Affiliates, Design and Content) to ensure the integration of marketing efforts. Leverage cross-departmental insights to achieve optimal campaign performance.
    Data-Driven Performance Analysis: Oversee the setup, tracking, and detailed performance analysis of all campaigns using Adservers and other tools. Continuously monitor KPIs, analyzing results against set targets, and providing actionable recommendations to senior management.
    Team Collaboration: Foster a high-performance culture within the marketing team. Serve as a key advisor in marketing tech discussions and proactively improve data collection and performance.
    Creative collaboration: Work on developing design briefs for performance, on the managed campaigns. Work closely with agencies and internal teams to ensure that all creative work meets the highest standards and is aligned with market goals.
    Budget & Spend Management: Monitoring of campaign budgets, ensuring efficient use of resources and staying within agreed financial parameters. Provide regular reports on spend and ROI to senior leadership.
    Rapid Market Adaptation: Demonstrate the ability to adapt to market changes and new opportunities quickly, maintaining flexibility and agility in a fast-paced environment. Ensure that marketing initiatives are always aligned with the latest industry trends.
    Stakeholder Reporting & Communication: Provide regular, comprehensive reports to senior management, highlighting campaign performance, market insights, and potential areas for growth. Deliver actionable recommendations and ensure transparency in performance metrics.
    Any other task/responsibility which may be related and/or connected to the role of Programmatic and Marketing Tech Manager.

Knowledge, Experience & Skills:

    Minimum of 2 years’ experience in a media management role within the iGaming industry.
    Marketing degree or marketing post graduate certification.
    Fluent in both written and spoken English with knowledge in another language considered an advantage
    Experience in working on performance marketing campaigns (Programmatic, Fixed CPM, PPC, and Social media).

title: After-Sales Engineer / Technical Customer Support – Battery Energy Storage Systems (m/f/d) (Kundendienstmonteur/in, -techniker/in)
description:
Über uns

Die RCT Energy Technology GmbH mit Sitz in Konstanz ist ein technologieorientiertes Unternehmen im Bereich Energiespeichersysteme und intelligenter Energielösungen.

Unser Tätigkeitsfeld umfasst Energiespeichersysteme, Wechselrichter, Batterielösungen und Energiemanagementsysteme für private, gewerbliche, industrielle und großtechnische Anwendungen. Dabei stehen technische Innovation, Produktqualität, zuverlässige Projektabwicklung und die Anforderungen unserer Kunden im Mittelpunkt.

Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt einen After-Sales Engineer (m/w/d) für Batteriespeichersysteme mit Arbeitsort in den Niederlanden.

Ihre Aufgaben

• Sicherstellung eines hochwertigen technischen Supports und Projektmanagements für unsere CESS-Systeme und gewerblichen Speicherlösungen.
• Planung und Koordination von Installations- und Inbetriebnahmeeinsätzen in Zusammenarbeit mit internen und externen Partnern.
• Überwachung und Sicherstellung der Einhaltung von Service-Level-Agreements (SLA) sowie Wartungsvereinbarungen.
• Analyse und Behebung technischer Störungen per Remote-Support oder vor Ort einschließlich der Organisation der erforderlichen Ersatzteilversorgung.
• Technische Unterstützung von Installationspartnern während der Inbetriebnahme von Systemen per Remote-Support oder vor Ort.
• Aufbau und kontinuierliche Weiterentwicklung eines projektbezogenen Berichtssystems zur Nachverfolgung und Optimierung der Supportprozesse.
• Bearbeitung technischer Anfragen über das zentrale Servicepostfach sowie systematische Erfassung und Nachverfolgung der Vorgänge im Ticketsystem.
• Bearbeitung und Nachverfolgung von Rückgabe- und Reklamationsverfahren (RMA) für CESS- und RESS-Systeme.

Ihr Profil

• Erfolgreich abgeschlossene technische Ausbildung oder ein Studium, vorzugsweise in Elektrotechnik, Energietechnik oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung.
• Erfahrung im technischen Kundensupport oder im Servicebereich von Energiespeichersystemen ist von Vorteil.
• Qualifikationen wie VCA, NEN 3140 VP und NEN 1010 sind von Vorteil.
• Ausgeprägte Problemlösungsfähigkeit sowie eine strukturierte und kundenorientierte Arbeitsweise.
• Teamfähigkeit, Organisationstalent und ausgeprägte Kommunikationsfähigkeit.
• Arbeits- beziehungsweise Wohnort in den Niederlanden sowie die Bereitschaft, unsere Geschäftstätigkeiten innerhalb der Europäischen Union per Remote-Support oder vor Ort zu unterstützen.
• Sehr gute Englisch- oder Deutschkenntnisse; Chinesischkenntnisse sind von Vorteil.
• Bereitschaft zu regelmäßigen Dienstreisen.
• Gültiger Führerschein und praktische Fahrerfahrung; ein eigenes Fahrzeug ist von Vorteil.

Wir bieten

• Eine anspruchsvolle und abwechslungsreiche Tätigkeit in einem dynamischen und zukunftsorientierten Unternehmen der erneuerbaren Energien.
• Die Möglichkeit, innovative großtechnische Batteriespeicherlösungen aktiv mitzugestalten und einen Beitrag zu einer nachhaltigen Energiezukunft zu leisten.
• Ein teamorientiertes Arbeitsumfeld mit flachen Hierarchien und kurzen Entscheidungswegen.

title: Medior asset management professional
description:
Minimaal 3 jaar ervaring in assetmanagement, onderhoudsengineering of technisch projectmanagement
Aantoonbare ervaring met het zelfstandig uitvoeren van analyses, implementaties of verbetertrajecten
Je kunt verschillende perspectieven techniek, proces en organisatie, met elkaar verbinden
Je schakelt makkelijk met stakeholders, begeleid collega's en houdt overzicht in dynamische projecten
je werkt gestructureerd en weet hoe je resultaten borgt in systemen, processen en gedrag,
je kent methodieken als ISO 55001 LCC, FME(C)A of ITIL en weet deze toe te passen
afgeronde HBO of WO-opleiding
stevige persoonlijkheid met een scherp analytisch vermogen
klantgericht, professioneel en communiceert makkelijk met verchillende lagen in een organisatie

Werken bij Compris:
Bij Compris doen ze het net even anders. Er werken zo'n 45 bevlogen assetmanagement professionals die allemaal een zwak hebben voor techniek. Geen logge organisatie, maar korte lijnen, een betrokken directie en volop ruimte om jezelf te ontwikkelen.
Je werkt hier in een omgeving waar inhoud telt, maar menselijkheid net zo belangrijk is. Samen met collega's die niet alleen energie krijgen van het helpen van klanten, maar ook van elkaar.
Wat je gaat doen:
Als medior consultant pak je zelfstandig assetmanagementtrajecten op van begin tot eind. Je combineert tactisch advies met gewoon doen, en juist daar maak je het verschil. Je werkt aan projecten zoals het inrichten van prestatiecontracten op luchthavens of het slimmer maken van onderhoudsprocessen in de industrie.
Je vertaalt strategie naar uitvoering en zorgt dat plannen ook echt landen. Of het nu gaat om het opzetten van programmeringsprocessen bij een waterbedrijf of het verbeteren van storingsregistratie en werkvoorbereiding in onderhoudssoftware, jij brengt structuur en overzicht.
Je schakelt makkelijk met verschillende stakeholders en weet belangen bij elkaar te brengen in een duidelijke aanpak. Thema's als risico gestuurd onderhoud, datagedreven werken en het vertalen van beleid naar concrete onderhoudsplannen? Daar draai jij je hand niet voor om.
En ondertussen help je ook collega's vooruit. Je begeleidt junior consultants en draagt actief bij aan het delen en borgen van kennis binnen Compris.

description:
Als IT support medewerker ben jij het gezicht van een omvangrijk IT-project binnen de Rijksuniversiteit Groningen. Je ondersteunt medewerkers tijdens de overstap naar een nieuwe digitale werkplek en zorgt ervoor dat zij direct probleemloos aan de slag kunnen. Je combineert techniek met persoonlijk contact: de ene keer installeer je een laptop, de andere keer help je een medewerker op weg met de nieuwe software of los je een technisch probleem direct op.

- Kleine technische storingen en gebruikersvragen direct oplossen tijdens en na de uitrol.
- Oude hardware verzamelen, registreren en gereedmaken voor verdere verwerking of afvoer.

- Samenwerken met collega's en de projectmanager om de migratie volgens planning uit te voeren.

As part of the Purifiy project, we are looking for a PhD candidate on the purification of pyrolyzed waste plastics.
Pyrolysis offers a promising path to valorize difficult-to-recycle plastic waste. However, harmful contaminants present in such waste streams (e.g., halogens, metals, and nitrogen compounds) can cause equipment corrosion, catalyst deactivation, and compromise product quality. We are developing and evaluating innovative technologies to remove these contaminants in-situ during pyrolysis and ex-situ from the resulting vapor and liquid pyrolysis products. Through detailed analytical studies, lab- and pilot-scale testing, and technology evaluation, we aim to identify the most effective purification solutions.
What are you going to do?
· Investigate the structure and behavior of contaminants during pyrolysis through advanced analytical techniques
· Investigate contaminant structure-property relationships to guide purification technology selection

title: Technischer Außendienstmitarbeiter, Tischler, Maler und Lackierer (Tischler/in)
description:
Technischer Außendienstmitarbeiter, Tischler, Maler und Lackierer

Vossen T.N.

Die Firma Vossen T.N. aus Simpelveld in den Niederlanden (10 Min von Aachen-Zentrum) hat sich in den letzten 26 Jahren zu einem anerkannten Spezialunternehmen zur Sanierung von Fenstern, Türen, Fassaden, Bauelementen, Möbeln und Fußböden entwickelt. Die Firma Vossen T. N. ist durch langjährige Erfahrung in der Lage, die meisten Schäden an Oberflächen nach Einbruch, Sturm, Wasser und Brand mit Hilfe von modernen Reparatur-techniken zu beheben. Wir reparieren Schäden an der Materialien Aluminium, Holz und Kunststoff. Wir arbeiten mit den meisten Versicherungen in Deutschland, Belgien, Luxemburg und den Niederlanden zusammen.

Die Stelle

Für unsere technische Abteilung suchen wir eine(n) technische(n) Mitarbeiter(in) in Festanstellung Vollzeit für 40 Stunden in der Woche. Wir suchen eine(n) technisch begabte(n), selbstständig arbeitende(n) Tischler(in) oder Maler(in)/Lackierer(in) mit Erfahrung für den Außendienst. Sie sind tätig bei unseren Kunden vor Ort, verfügen über einen zugeteilten Lieferwagen und beginnen täglich in unserer Niederlassung.

Zu Ihren Aufgaben gehört die Reparatur von Fenstern, Türen, Toren, Möbeln und Fußböden.

Nach der Einarbeitung besteht die Möglichkeit einen festen Vertrag auf unbestimmte Zeit zu erhalten.

Die Anstellung erfolgt nach deutschem Sozialrecht (Krankenkasse, Arbeitslosen-versicherung, Berufsgenossenschaft etc.).

Sie

Haben Sie eine abgeschlossene Berufsausbildung in den oben aufgeführten Berufszweigen, verfügen Sie über entsprechende Erfahrungen und gute kommunikative Eigenschaften? Dann ist diese Stelle vielleicht etwas für Sie. Kenntnisse der niedeländischen oder französichen Sprache ist von Vorteil.

title: Solutions Engineer (Informatiker/in)
description:
Solutions Engineer (Data & Graph)
About the Role

Mendix, a Siemens business, powers hybrid agentic workforces by enabling
organizations to build, scale and orchestrate agents and applications faster by
combining low-code, AI, data, and integrations into a unified platform.
The Technical Solutions Marketing team builds technical
credibility for Mendix through validated architectures, reusable proof points,
and real-world implementations. In this role, you will work directly with
customers and the field to prove high-value use cases through lighthouse
implementations, then package what works into reusable patterns, components,
and technical narratives that scale across GTM and delivery ecosystems.

Responsibilities

- Design
and build knowledge graphs and ontologies that underpin Mendix's AI
solutions, technical demos, and customer implementations.
- Own
the data and graph architecture workstream within integrated team
solutions, working alongside Solutions Engineers who cover the application
and AI layers.
- Turn
validated customer work into reusable assets: reference architectures,
blueprints, accelerators, and repeatable patterns.
- Contribute
to customer engagements, events, and analyst briefings as the team's
expert in data and graph.
- Ground
GTM positioning and storytelling in validated technical proof points,
supporting high-impact moments like executive demos and analyst briefings.

Requirements

- Demonstrable
hands-on experience designing and building knowledge graphs and
ontologies.
- Strong
understanding of graph data modelling, semantic modelling, and ontology
design.
- Experience
with graph database platforms and query languages (e.g. SPARQL, Cypher, or
equivalent).
- Data
engineering fundamentals: pipelines, data preparation, and integration
with enterprise systems (ERP, CRM, operational systems).
- Ability
to translate data and graph architectures into reusable patterns and clear
technical narratives.
- Strong
communication and collaboration skills across Product, GTM, engineering,
and customer stakeholders.

Note: This is not a data analyst or business
intelligence role. The focus is graph data, knowledge modelling, and how that
layer supports AI and agentic applications.
What Success Looks Like

- Knowledge
graph demos and reference architectures that hold up in customer and
analyst sessions and are ready to reuse across the team.
- Recognised
as the team's go-to on data and graph in customer engagements.
- Packaged
architectures adopted by the team and reused across go-to-market and
delivery.
- Implementation
learnings feeding product direction and positioning in a consistent way.

Why this role
This role sits at the foundation of agentic enterprise
solutions are grounded in real data, and plays a central part in how knowledge
graph architectures are proven, packaged, and scaled.
You will design the graph layer that gives AI agents
structured context and memory at enterprise scale, work alongside the
application and AI Solutions Engineers to take those implementations in front
of customers and analysts, and feed what you learn back into Product and Go To
Market teams.

title: After-Sales Engineer / Technical Customer Support – Battery Energy Storage Systems (m/f/d) (Kundendienstmonteur/in, -techniker/in)
description:

Die RCT Energy Technology GmbH mit Sitz in Konstanz ist ein technologieorientiertes Unternehmen im Bereich Energiespeichersysteme und intelligenter Energielösungen.

Unser Tätigkeitsfeld umfasst Energiespeichersysteme, Wechselrichter, Batterielösungen und Energiemanagementsysteme für private, gewerbliche, industrielle und großtechnische Anwendungen. Zur Verstärkung unseres Teams suchen wir zum nächstmöglichen Zeitpunkt einen After-Sales Engineer (m/w/d) für Batteriespeichersysteme mit Arbeitsort in den Niederlanden.

• Erfolgreich abgeschlossene technische Ausbildung oder ein Studium, vorzugsweise in Elektrotechnik, Energietechnik oder einer vergleichbaren Fachrichtung.
• Erfahrung im technischen Kundensupport oder im Servicebereich von Energiespeichersystemen ist von Vorteil.

• Teamfähigkeit, Organisationstalent und ausgeprägte Kommunikationsfähigkeit.
• Arbeits- beziehungsweise Wohnort in den Niederlanden sowie die Bereitschaft, unsere Geschäftstätigkeiten innerhalb der Europäischen Union per Remote-Support oder vor Ort zu unterstützen.
• Sehr gute Englisch- oder Deutschkenntnisse; Chinesischkenntnisse sind von Vorteil.

• Gültiger Führerschein und praktische Fahrerfahrung; ein eigenes Fahrzeug ist von Vorteil.

Wir bieten

• Eine anspruchsvolle und abwechslungsreiche Tätigkeit in einem dynamischen und zukunftsorientierten Unternehmen der erneuerbaren Energien.

title: Front Office Agent - Full Time (Empfangsmitarbeiter/in (Hotel))
description:
Front Office Agent - Full Time

Job Description

The focus of this role is on the professional care of our hotel guests – from a warm welcome at check-in to a genuine farewell at departure. Your duties will also include the following:

- Looking after our guests, including check-in and check-out
- Reviewing and processing bookings, overbookings and options
- Invoicing, including managing payments, as well as cash transactions and cashing up
- Organisational and administrative tasks in both our front and back office (e.g. managing no-shows, answering emails) and supporting our F&B Team in peak hours.
- Gaining interdepartmental insights into new areas of activity by working in our multicultural teams
- Supporting our F&B team during breakfast times and for drinks at the bar

Benefits:

- Bonus program: The better the guests rate their stay, the higher the bonus!
- Make an international career: Discover a variety of career opportunities in our hotels nationally and internationally, or join one of our numerous new openings.
- Staff discounts: Benefit from attractive staff rates in all of our hotels throughout Europe and the USA.
- Develop personally and professionally: With an extensive onboarding, annual trainings and coaching at our One University, you will hit the ground running.
- Celebrate together: Whether it's a summer party, holiday party or our annual international soccer tournament - we celebrate successes together with the team.

Qualifications

Whether you are a hotel professional or changing careers – you will fit in here! Because personality and hosting skills are our priority. You will also:

- Have completed an apprenticeship in the hotel trade and/or have professional experience in the hotel/catering industry or be looking for a change of career
- Have an excellent sense of quality and service, as well as hosting skills and a passion for the hotel industry
- Be open and communicative and have a solid command of English
- Be a team player and willing to provide assistance across departments – we achieve our results together

description:

Mechatroniker/in (m/w/d); Elektroniker/in Automatisierungstechnik (m/w/d); Servicemonteur / Servicetechniker Wasseraufbereitung (m/w/d)

Stellenbeschreibung:
Du möchtest jeden Tag an etwas anderem arbeiten? Von Trinkwasseranlagen bis hin zu industriellen Prozesswasseranlagen bei namhaften Kunden aus der Lebensmittel-, Getränke- und Industriebranche? Du analysierst technische Störungen mit klarem Blick, arbeitest lösungsorientiert und möchtest eigenverantwortlich unterwegs sein?

Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig.

RWB Water ist Spezialist für industrielle Wasseraufbereitung und entwickelt, baut sowie betreibt Anlagen für Trinkwasser-, Prozesswasser- und Abwasseranwendungen. Zur Verstärkung unseres Serviceteams suchen wir einen engagierten Servicemonteur / Servicetechniker Wasseraufbereitung (m/w/d).

Deine Aufgaben

- Dein Arbeitstag beginnt direkt von zu Hause aus. Über das digitale Einsatzsystem erhältst du deine Aufträge und startest eigenständig zu unseren Kunden.
- Zu unseren Kunden gehören Wasserwerke, Krankenhäuser, Brauereien, Lebensmittelproduzenten sowie Industrieunternehmen.
- Durchführung von Wartungs-, Service- und Instandhaltungsarbeiten an Wasseraufbereitungsanlagen
- Analyse und Behebung technischer Störungen beim Kunden vor Ort
- Inbetriebnahme und Übergabe neuer Anlagen
- Durchführung vorbeugender Wartungen gemäß Wartungsplänen
- Unterstützung bei Umbauten, Optimierungen und kleineren Modifikationen
- Dokumentation der Serviceeinsätze und technischen Arbeiten
- Technische Beratung und Betreuung unserer Kunden
- Teilnahme am Bereitschaftsdienst im rotierenden System - einmal in 8 Wochen

Das bringst du mit

- Abgeschlossene technische Berufsausbildung, z. B. als Industriemechaniker, Mechatroniker, Anlagenmechaniker oder Elektroniker
- Berufserfahrung im technischen Service oder Anlagenbau von Vorteil
- Technisches Verständnis in Mechanik, Pumpentechnik, Rohrleitungsbau oder Elektrotechnik
- Erfahrung im Bereich Wasseraufbereitung oder Verfahrenstechnik ist wünschenswert
- Selbstständige und strukturierte Arbeitsweise
- Kundenorientiertes Auftreten und Teamfähigkeit
- Führerschein Klasse B
- Reisebereitschaft im regionalen Einsatzgebiet

Das bieten wir dir

- Einen sicheren Arbeitsplatz in einem international tätigen Unternehmen
- Eine abwechslungsreiche Tätigkeit mit hoher Eigenverantwortung
- Intensive Einarbeitung und individuelle Weiterbildungsmöglichkeiten
- Modern ausgestattetes Servicefahrzeug
- Attraktive Vergütung inklusive Zuschlägen für Bereitschaftsdienste
- Betriebliche Altersvorsorge
- Moderne Arbeitsmittel wie Laptop und Mobiltelefon
- Kollegiales Arbeitsumfeld mit kurzen Entscheidungswegen
- Langfristige Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten innerhalb der Unternehmensgruppe
- Attraktives Jahresgehalt von 36 T€ bis 60 T€ – entsprechend deiner Qualifikation und Erfahrung.

Über uns

Die RWB Water Gruppe entwickelt nachhaltige Lösungen für industrielle und kommunale Wasseraufbereitung. Als Teil der internationalen METAWATER Group verbinden wir mittelständische Strukturen mit internationaler Technologiekompetenz.

Unsere Unternehmenskultur ist geprägt von Teamgeist, technischem Know-how und praxisorientiertem Handeln.
