title: Gymnasielärare i engelska och spanska 67% (vikariat), Nacka kommun
description:
Vill du förändra världen genom undervisning i engelska och spanska på gymnasiet? Drivs du av att undervisa motiverade och engagerade elever tillsammans med mycket kompetenta kollegor på en stabil, populär och välfungerande kommunal gymnasieskola? Vill du vara med att utveckla en av Sveriges bästa gymnasieskolor när skolan växer? Sök rollen och bli en del av YBC!

Då en av våra lärare kommer att vara tjänstledig för studier söker vi nu en engagerad lärare i engelska och spanska som vill bidra till vår utveckling. Är du den vi söker? Skicka in din ansökan redan idag!

Tjänsten är en tidsbegränsad anställning på 67 procent med start snarast och avslut i juni 2027. Det finns eventuell möjlighet till förlängning.

Ditt uppdrag

I rollen som lärare undervisar du våra klasser i engelska och spanska. Du ansvarar för planering, genomförande och utvärdering av undervisning i dina ämnen utifrån läroplanen. Du anpassar undervisningen efter elevernas behov, intressen och förutsättningar. Du följer upp, bedömer, betygsätter och dokumenterar elevers kunskapsutveckling. Vidare skapar du förtroendefulla relationer med elever, kollegor och vårdnadshavare. Som mentor är din viktigaste uppgift att motivera elever i deras studier samt stärka deras självkänsla och sociala utveckling.

Tillsammans med kollegor driver du olika projekt och samarbetar kring elevernas lärande. Du tillhör ett team där ni tillsammans arbetar med systematiskt kvalitetsarbete, övergripande skolutveckling samt utveckling av elevernas gymnasieprogram. Du träffar dina ämneskollegor kontinuerligt för planering, bedömning och betygsättning.

Din erfarenhet

För denna tjänst krävs att du har:

    lärarlegitimation med ämnesbehörighet i engelska och spanska för gymnasiet
    god digital kompetens med vana av att arbeta med digitala pedagogiska verktyg
    god förmåga att uttrycka dig väl på svenska i tal och skrift.

Det är meriterande om du även har:

    erfarenhet av att arbeta som lärare i engelska och spanska på gymnasiet eller motsvarande nivå
    ämnesbehörighet för gymnasiet i andra ämnen än engelska och spanska
    erfarenhet av mentorskap.

Är det här du?

För att lyckas i rollen som lärare hos oss behöver du både intresse och förmåga att samarbeta, kommunicera och skapa goda relationer med elever, vårdnadshavare och kollegor. Din relationsskapande och förtroendeingivande förmåga skapar trygghet, tillit och en bra grund för lustfyllt lärande. I klassrummet är du en tydlig, trygg och lyhörd ledare som motiverar, engagerar och utvecklar dina elever. För att både trivas och lyckas hos oss är det även viktigt att du är kreativ och entreprenöriell. Med ett kreativt och nytänkande förhållningssätt hittar du lösningar på problem och utmaningar samt ser möjligheter. Vi lägger stor vikt vid personlig lämplighet.

Vi erbjuder

YBC är en nytänkande och innovativ gymnasieskola i Sickla med cirka 1000 elever uppdelade på tre program; ekonomi, naturvetenskap och samhällsvetenskap. På ekonomiprogrammet finns dessutom en specialpedagogisk verksamhet för elever med autism. Vi är en modern skola med mycket god digital infrastruktur samt väldigt ändamålsenliga och fina lokaler. Undervisningen grundar sig i vår vision om att vi vill förändra världen, en vision som är levande i hela verksamheten. Våra ledord, kreativitet och entreprenörskap, syns tydligt i arbetet med socialt entreprenörskap i alla årskurser och program. Som Erasmusackrediterad skola deltar vi även i många olika internationella projekt och samarbeten.

Som lärare hos oss får du en mycket stimulerande och utvecklingsorienterad arbetsplats med motiverade, duktiga och intresserade elever samt kompetenta och drivna kollegor. Du får möjlighet att samarbeta nära med skolans andra kemilärare, som är disputerad och har lång erfarenhet av kemiundervisning. Det ger goda möjligheter till både kvalificerat ämnesstöd och kollegialt lärande. Vi har en väl utvecklad samarbetskultur och erbjuder mentorstöd till nyanställda. Du får stor frihet att vara kreativ samt att påverka och utveckla din roll och undervisning utifrån kunskap, erfarenhet och intresse. Du blir en del av en stabil, trygg, populär och välfungerande kommunal gymnasieskola där både elever och kollegor trivs och lär sig av varandra. Läs mer om oss här och se en film här

Som anställd i Nacka kommun har du bland annat tillgång till förmåner som friskvårdsbidrag på 3 000 kr per år, köp av SL-kort via nettolöneavdrag, gym, förmånscykel och en mångsidig intern stödfunktion.

Intresserad?

Vi rekryterar utan personligt brev och bedömer ansökan utifrån CV och dina svar på frågor som du får besvara i samband med ansökan. Urval och intervjuer kan komma att ske löpande under ansökningstiden. Välkommen med din ansökan senast 2026-08-25!

Bakgrundskontroll kan komma att tillämpas.

Tjänsten tillsätts under förutsättning att den inte behöver tas i anspråk för intern omplacering.

Besök gärna Nackas kommunala skolor och förskolors karriärsida här

Nacka är en av Sveriges mest attraktiva och välrenommerade kommuner. Med fokus på mål, resultat, hållbart medarbetarengagemang och ständig utveckling strävar Nacka efter att bli bäst på att vara kommun. Nacka kommun är arbetsgivaren för dig som med stor frihet förnyar och gör skillnad.

title: Audionom
description:
Hörselvården ingår i rehab kommunikation där även Got-IT resurscenter, syncentral och tolkcentral är samlade. Vi har ett fint samarbete mellan verksamheterna kring våra gemensamma patienter.

På hörselvården arbetar i dag ett härligt gäng medarbetare med hög kompetens och lång erfarenhet; audionomer, kurator, syn/hörselinstruktör, sekreterare och tekniker.

Vi söker nu en audionomkollega som vill arbeta hos oss för en av våra audionomer som är föräldraledig.

Ta chansen och upplev en höst/vinter på Gotland och jobba i en mycket fin arbetsgrupp!

Dina arbetsuppgifter

Audionomerna på hörselvården Gotland arbetar med hela rehabiliteringsprocessen, från nybesök med hörselmätningar till utprovning och utvärdering av hörapparater samt tekniska hjälpmedel. Arbetet består av både pedagogiska och tekniska insatser.

I det dagliga arbetet träffar du vuxna patienter i alla åldrar med olika typ och grad av hörselnedsättning.

Vem är du?

Du som söker är legitimerad audionom. Meriterande är kunskap och kännedom om aktuella hörapparater enligt avtal.

Du ska ha goda kunskaper i såväl hörselutredning som rehabilitering. Din samarbetsförmåga är god och du tycker om att arbeta i team såväl som att arbeta självständigt.

Stor vikt läggs vid personlig lämplighet.

Inför beslut om anställning görs bakgrundskontroll genom utdrag ur belastningsregistret.

Varför välja Region Gotland?

Vi är öns största arbetsgivare – med över 200 olika yrken och 7000 medarbetare i Sveriges enda kombinerade region och kommun. Tillsammans utvecklar vi ett hållbart, tryggt och välmående Gotland för alla som bor på och besöker ön.

På Gotland finns ett rikt kulturliv, storslagen natur och en kreativ entreprenörsanda. Över 61 000 personer har valt att kalla Gotland för sitt hem, året runt. Är du inte en av oss än, men nyfiken på att bli? Läs mer om livet på ön på www.gotland.com/flytta-hit

Vi värnar om våra medarbetare och är stolta över våra förmåner. Läs gärna mer på www.gotland.se/formaner

På Instagramkontot @viarregiongotland kan du följa våra medarbetare och se bredden i våra olika verksamheter.

Så rekryterar vi

Vi arbetar enligt kompetensbaserad rekryteringsmetod och lägger därför stor vikt vid personlig lämplighet i enlighet med de kompetenser som beskrivs i annonsen. På så vis jobbar vi även aktivt för att motverka diskriminering.

Vi är måna om säkerhet och kvalité i våra rekryteringar och du kan därför komma att omfattas av kontroller inför anställning. Om det är aktuellt får du mer information av rekryterare. ID-handling och personbevis behöver alltid uppvisas.

Tjänsten tillsätts under förutsättning att den inte behöver erbjudas medarbetare med företrädesrätt.

title: Stödpedagoger sökes till Unika Landskrona
description:
Om Unika Landskrona

Unika Landskrona rymmer två verksamheter med varsin karaktär: en gruppbostaden med sex platser, och en servicebostad med åtta platser. Verksamheterna är tillståndspliktiga och bedrivs med godkännande från Inspektionen för vård och omsorg (IVO).

Vi välkomnar personer som tillhör personkrets 1 enligt LSS, det vill säga personer med intellektuell funktionsnedsättning, autism eller autismliknande tillstånd. Vår ledstjärna är enkel men betydelsefull: varje boende ska ha verklig möjlighet att delta i samhället och utvecklas utifrån sina egna förutsättningar. Hos oss möts de boende av trygghet, respekt och ett genuint engagemang – varje dag.

Landskrona – staden vid Sundet

Landskrona ligger vackert vid Öresunds kust i västra Skåne, mitt emellan Malmö och Helsingborg. Här förenas småstadens charm och lugn med storstadens närhet – tåget tar dig till Helsingborg på en kvart och till Malmö på en dryg halvtimme, vilket gör staden lätt att pendla både till och från. Landskrona bjuder på ett levande kulturliv, historiska pärlor som Citadellet, hamnmiljöer och strandpromenader – och från kajen går färjan ut till idylliska Ven. Det är en stad i positiv utveckling, med plats för både livskvalitet och yrkesmässig växtkraft.

Rollen som Stödpedagog

Som stödpedagog hos oss står den enskildes vilja och behov alltid i centrum. Du ger stöd och service utifrån de boendes egna önskemål – i hemmet såväl som vid fritidsaktiviteter – och bidrar till att varje person får en aktiv och meningsfull tillvaro. Med din pedagogiska kompetens ser du varje individs unika förutsättningar och anpassar arbetet därefter.

Eftersom de boendes behov ser olika ut är ingen dag den andra lik. Det gör arbetet omväxlande, stimulerande och ständigt utvecklande. Du arbetar nära de boende tillsammans med engagerade kollegor, och har – i nära samråd med verksamhetschef – en nyckelroll i att driva och utveckla verksamhetens pedagogiska arbete framåt. I tjänsten ingår även vissa delegerade hälso- och sjukvårdsuppgifter.

Vem är du?

Vi söker dig som bygger relationer med värme och tillit. Du är lugn och stabil som person och behåller ett balanserat, realistiskt perspektiv även när vardagen bjuder på utmaningar. Din samarbetsförmåga är god – du är lyhörd i mötet med andra och trivs med att samverka, både inom teamet och med externa kontakter. Som person är du självständig, ödmjuk och ansvarstagande, med ett äkta engagemang för omsorgsarbete och en förmåga att alltid se individen bakom behovet.

Vi lägger stor vikt vid personlig lämplighet.

Krav:

    

Examen från stödpedagogutbildningen 200 YH poäng eller 60 HP inom pedagogik.

    

Erfarenhet samt kunskap om målgruppen LSS vuxna personkrets 1.

    

Grundläggande kunskaper om hushållsarbete såsom kost och hygien.

    

Datorvana samt goda kunskaper i svenska språket, i tal och skrift.

Meriterande om du därtill har:

    

Erfarenhet av arbetsledning

    

Erfarenhet av att ha jobbat med människor med autism och utmanande beteende.

    

Erfarenhet av att arbeta med individer med komplex psykosocial beteendeproblematik.

    

Erfarenhet av tydliggörande kommunikation och lågaffektivt bemötande.

Vi lägger stor vikt vid personlig lämplighet.

Anställningsvillkor

Anställningsform:  6 månader provanställning Tjänstgöringsgrad: cirka 80% Arbetstid: dag, kväll, jour och helger Tillträde: Enligt överenskommelse, vi ser positivt på om du kan tillträda inom kort. Kollektivavtal: Vi är kollektivavtalsbundna till Vårdföretagarna/Kommunal, Bransch E.

title: Logistikchef
description:
Arbetsbeskrivning

Rollen som logistikchef hos oss innebär ett helhetsansvar för logistikflödet – från planering till leverans – med fokus på leveransprecision, kvalitet och kostnadseffektivitet. Du arbetar både strategiskt och operativt – nära verksamheten, affären och våra samarbetspartners. Du blir en del av fabrikens ledningsgrupp och rapporterar direkt till Plant Manager. Du har också en Planeringschef underställd Logistikchef som ansvarar för ca 17 pers. På hela logistik arbetar det ca 130 pers inkl konsulter Verksamheten är en högvolymsfabrik som levererar över 550 000 artiklar per vecka till ett flertal stora kunder. Vi söker en ledare som vill vara med på vår utvecklings- och förändringsresa. Rollen är på 100 % och utgår från vår fabrik i Färgelanda.

Ansvarsområden:

    Resultat- och leveransansvar: Säkerställa hög leveransprecision, kundnöjdhet samt uppföljning av relevanta KPI:er kopplade till logistik och flöde.
    Logistikstyrning: Ansvara för lagerstyrning, kapacitetsplanering samt utveckling av effektiva material- och informationsflöden.
    Leverantörssamverkan: Säkerställa effektiva samarbeten med leverantörer och interna funktioner för att optimera flöden och tillgänglighet.
    Förbättringsarbete: Driva och implementera förbättringsinitiativ enligt våra principer.
    Hälsa och säkerhet: Driva och prioritera arbetsmiljö- och säkerhetsfrågor som en naturlig del av den dagliga verksamheten.

Kompetenser:

    Tydlig och kommunikativ ledare: Du är en trygg chef som sätter klara ramar och arbetsbeskrivningar, samtidigt som du coachar ditt team till att tänka nytt och fatta egna beslut.
    Prestigelös och handlingskraftig: Du är absolut "hands on" när det krävs, är lyhörd för organisationen men har samtidigt modet att stå fast vid fattade beslut.
    Analytisk och datadriven: Du fattar beslut baserat på fakta och data. Du har lätt för att göra analyser som räddar dagen här och nu, men också säkrar flödet för framtiden.
    Resultatorienterad: Du arbetar strukturerat mot uppsatta mål och följer upp verksamheten genom nyckeltal.

Kvalifikationer:

    Erfarenhet: Gedigen och stor erfarenhet inom logistik samt ett dokumenterat framgångsrikt ledarskap.
    Branschbakgrund: Erfarenhet från fordonsindustrin (Automotive) och förståelse för dess komplexa processer är starkt meriterande. Alternativt har du bakgrund från någon större logistikaktör.
    System och IT: God vana av SAP samt mycket starka kunskaper i Excel.
    Språk: Då vi arbetar på en internationell marknad krävs mycket goda kunskaper i både svenska och engelska i tal och skrift.
    Geografiskt fokus: Vi ser gärna att du bor i exempelvis Trollhättan, Uddevalla eller Stenungsund med omnejd då det passar bäst för pendling.

I den här rekryteringen samarbetar Artifex med Randstad. Då vi går in i en semesterperiod kommer urval och intervjuer ske med start under v32. Tjänsten kan komma att bli tillsatt innan sista ansökningsdag, ansök därför så snart som möjligt.

title: Assistant General Manager
description:
Dream Big - Join Basta New Opening! 🍕

About Basta

Basta is more than a restaurant—it's a place where people connect. Inspired by the warmth and spirit of Italy, we bring together great food, genuine hospitality and passionate teams to create memorable experiences for every guest. Whether you're in the kitchen or on the floor, you'll be part of a team that brings energy, personality and pride to everything it does.

Part of Urban Italian Group

Urban Italian Group is one of Europe's fastest-growing hospitality groups, bringing together distinctive restaurant brands, passionate people and memorable guest experiences. As we continue to grow, so do the opportunities for those who want to build their careers with us.

The Role

As Assistant General Manager, you will support the General Manager in running a strong, efficient and high-energy restaurant. This is a hands-on operational role for someone who enjoys leading service, developing the team and keeping the restaurant moving with pace, warmth and control.

You will play an important part in keeping standards consistent, supporting cost control and helping the team grow through clear training, patience and strong day-to-day leadership.

What you'll be doing

    

Lead and support smooth, efficient service when the GM is not present.

    

Support the GM with scheduling, labour control and daily restaurant organisation.

    

Train, coach and support team members to improve performance and service standards.

    

Keep service standards, guest experience and restaurant routines consistent.

    

Use KPIs, cost awareness and operational judgement to support stronger results.

    

Create a positive, hands-on team culture where people feel supported and accountable.

You'll thrive in this role if you

We’re looking for someone who is service-led, practical and ready to grow with the restaurant.

    

Strong restaurant service background, ideally in a busy, fast-paced operation.

    

Confident leading the floor and supporting the team during service.

    

Good understanding of KPIs, labour, cost control and restaurant standards.

    

Flexible approach to scheduling and the rhythm of restaurant life.

    

Patient, team-focused and able to train people in a clear and supportive way.

    

Good English level; Swedish is a strong advantage, with willingness to keep learning.

    

Someone looking to stay, grow and build a long-term career with Basta.

Our culture and values

We believe we work with people, not food. Guided by our values of Trust, Inclusion, Passion and Entrepreneurship, we’re committed to creating a workplace where everyone feels welcome, valued and empowered to grow.

What do we offer?

    

Be part of one of Europe’s fastest-growing hospitality groups.

    

Build your career across multiple brands and countries.

    

Work alongside talented people who genuinely love hospitality.

    

International career opportunities.

    

Referral bonus scheme.

    

Shared accommodation (where applicable).

    

Friends for life.

Sound like your kind of place?

If you are excited by joining us, we would love to hear from you. Bring your energy, personality and passion for Italian food to Basta.

Urban Italian Group is committed to fair and inclusive recruitment. We welcome applications from people of all backgrounds. If you need a reasonable adjustment at any stage of the selection process, please tell our Talent Acquisition Team.

title: Senior IAM Engineer
description:
About the Company

At Avaron, you get the security of permanent employment combined with the variety of working at different customers. We place specialists across everything from tech, IT and industry to project management and business support – and whatever the assignment, you have a consultant manager who is there for you and your development.

About the Role

You will join a highly skilled IAM team working at the heart of a complex enterprise environment where identity, security, and platform engineering are tightly connected. The team designs, builds, and operates Identity and Access Management platforms across both on-prem and cloud environments, with solutions that are deeply integrated into DevOps toolchains and digital platforms.

In this role, you will help evolve the IAM landscape by turning technical and business needs into secure, scalable solutions. You will work closely with development, security, cloud, and infrastructure teams, and play an important part in strengthening IAM capabilities that support the organization’s broader cloud journey. It is a great opportunity for you if you enjoy combining architecture, hands-on engineering, and security in a modern platform environment.

Job Description

    You will design and implement IAM solutions and architectures for hybrid environments.
    You will operate, maintain, and further develop IAM platforms and supporting infrastructure.
    You will support cloud and platform onboarding by establishing secure IAM patterns.
    You will troubleshoot identity-related issues across integrated systems and drive resolution in a structured way.
    You will work with compliance and security policies to ensure robust and secure access management.
    You will collaborate closely with cross-functional teams to improve the overall security posture.
    You will contribute to IAM capabilities that enable scalable, secure, and compliant cloud services.

Requirements

    5 years or more experience within IAM engineering, with expert hands-on experience in access management tools.
    Good knowledge of networking fundamentals such as TLS, DNS, proxies, firewalls, and VPNs.
    Advanced knowledge of certificate management and PKI, including handling SSL/TLS certificates.
    Advanced knowledge of identity federation technologies such as OpenID Connect and OAuth2.
    Experience managing different IDP solutions.
    Good knowledge of Single Sign-On and Multi Factor Authentication solutions, for example FIDO2.
    Advanced knowledge of DevSecOps tools and platform management with Kubernetes, Docker, Git, and GitHub Actions.
    Advanced knowledge in programming languages such as Java, Python, Go, Spring, or JavaScript.
    Good knowledge of Linux, LDAP, OpenShift, and infrastructure as code with Terraform, Ansible, and Helm.
    Experience working in hybrid and multi-cloud enterprise environments, including secure integration across multiple cloud providers and on-premises platforms.
    Hands-on experience with one or more enterprise identity platforms such as Microsoft Entra ID, Keycloak, or Curity.
    Experience operating in complex and highly integrated IT environments.
    Advanced troubleshooting capabilities and a strong understanding of IT infrastructure, with the ability to diagnose and resolve complex identity and access issues across diverse systems and environments.

What We Offer

    Permanent employment at Avaron AB
    Occupational pension
    Wellness allowance of SEK 5,000 per year

Application

Selections are made on an ongoing basis – apply as soon as you can.

title: R&D Professional (Physical Metallurgy): Temporary Position
description:
At Alleima, we believe in delivering the highest quality products to our customers. That is why we invest heavily in research and development, and our unit for Physical Metallurgy is in the forefront of this effort. As part of our Strategic Research organization, the unit provides expert support to all of our divisions: Tube, Strip and Kanthal. We generate high-quality testing results, develop new and existing testing methods, and participate in cutting-edge research development projects, all to ensure we stay ahead of the curve.

If you hold a Master’s degree in Metallurgy, Materials Science, or Physics and are interested in working with surface analysis, heat treatment, and physical properties, we invite you to apply for a temporary position at the Strategic Research Labs at Alleima. We are looking for driven individuals with a strong commitment to delivering high-quality results. This is a great opportunity to gain valuable experience as part of our innovative team in Sandviken, Sweden—don’t miss your chance to join us!

This position is expected to start from 2026-09-01 to 2026-12-31.

Your Role

The unit Physical Metallurgy, which is an integral part of Strategic Research Labs consists of several characterization and analytical techniques. These include surface analysis techniques known as glow discharge optical emission spectroscopy (GD-OES), Physical property measurements, X-ray diffraction (XRD), light and electron microscopes (LOM+SEMs+TEM+EPMA), sample preparation laboratories and dilatometers. We have a group of highly competent and skillful engineers and technicians. The current position mainly involves collaborating with group members working with GD-OES, Interferometer, Physical & Magnetic properties and Heat Treatment. The responsibilities of the current position are as follows:

      -        Perform measurements according to the expectations of our clients and be able to communicate the results.

      -        Collaborate effectively with other laboratory engineers in planning and executing the measurements.

      -        Take responsibility for the machines & instruments by collaborating with the suppliers in the case of maintenance and breakdowns.

      -        Support other lab members in future investments in the areas you work with.

About You

We are looking for an enthusiastic individual with a Masters’s degree in Metallurgy, Materials Science, or Physics. While prior experience in our competence area is a plus, what matters to us is your eagerness to learn, develop and grow. If you have spent time in a laboratory environment, that´s an advantage. Knowledge of metallic materials, manufacturing processes, microstructures, that’s fantastic, but don´t worry if you´re not an expert just yet – we´re here to help develop those skills. Experience working with GD-OES, Interferometer, and instruments for measuring Physical properties can also be a merit. You should be able to communicate in Swedish, both verbally and in writing. As we work in a global environment, communication skills in English will be good/advantageous.

Your personal qualities are essential for this role. At our core, we value strong personal qualities such as curiosity, creativity, self-motivation, patience, and a solution-oriented mindset. You are well-organized and structured, with a clear sense of ownership and commitment to your responsibilities. You thrive both independently and as part of a team, demonstrating adaptability and a willingness to support others when needed. If you’re driven to thrive and grow in our dynamic environment, we´re excited to welcome you on board as the catalyst for our success!

We are a company with an open-minded culture, actively working to create a workplace that is characterized by diversity and inclusion.

Additional Information

title: Verksamhetsansvarig för Låktatjåkko fjällstationen
description:
Verksamhetsansvarig för Låktatjåkko fjällstationen

Här får du kombinera närvarande ledarskap, värdskap och operativ drift med ansvar för ekonomi, personal och utveckling av en verksamhet utöver det vanliga.

Låktatjåkko Fjällstation är en del av Lapland Resorts och ligger i väglöst land, cirka nio kilometer från Björkliden. Fjällstationen erbjuder boende, restaurang och personliga fjällupplevelser i en miljö där väder, transporter och naturens förutsättningar är en naturlig del av vardagen.

Om rollen

Som verksamhetsansvarig har du det övergripande ansvaret för verksamheten på Låktatjåkko Fjällstation.

Du ansvarar för den dagliga driften, gästupplevelsen, ekonomin och ett team på cirka 10–13 medarbetare bestående av Låktavärdar och kökspersonal, något som varierar mellan säsongerna.

Du leder verksamheten nära både gäster och medarbetare och säkerställer att fjällstationen bedrivs med hög kvalitet, god service, säkerhet och ekonomi.

Rollen är delvis operativ. Det innebär att du planerar, leder och följer upp verksamheten, samtidigt som du vid behov arbetar tillsammans med teamet i den dagliga driften. Du rapporterar till F&B-manager och samarbetar nära med flera olika avdelningar.

Dina huvudsakliga ansvarsområden

I rollen ansvarar du bland annat för att:

    leda, planera och följa upp den dagliga verksamheten

    säkerställa en trygg, personlig och professionell gästupplevelse

    ha personalansvar för cirka 10–13 medarbetare

    rekrytera och introducera personal till verksamheten

    planera bemanning och schema utifrån verksamhetens behov och budget

    genomföra avstämningar, FeedForward-samtal och medarbetarsamtal

    följa upp intäkter, kostnader, inköp, lager och svinn

    planera leveranser och logistik utifrån fjällstationens särskilda förutsättningar

    säkerställa att hygien-, livsmedels- och säkerhetsrutiner följs

    ansvara för det löpande arbetsmiljöarbetet inom verksamheten

    utveckla fjällstationens arbetssätt, erbjudande och gästupplevelse

    delta i det operativa arbetet när verksamheten kräver det

Vem söker vi?

Vi söker dig som är en trygg, tydlig och lösningsorienterad ledare. Du trivs med ett stort eget ansvar och har förmåga att skapa struktur även när förutsättningarna förändras.

Du är prestigelös och bekväm med att växla mellan ledarskap, administration och operativt arbete. Du förstår att närvarande ledarskap på Låktatjåkko innebär att ibland arbeta sida vid sida med teamet.

För att trivas behöver du uppskatta fjällmiljön och vara bekväm med att arbetsplatsen ligger avskilt och nås till fots eller med olika transportlösningar beroende på säsong.

Vi tror att du har:

    Flera års erfarenhet av personalansvar och ledarskap

    1-2 års erfarenhet från hotell, restaurang, destination, turism eller liknande verksamhet

    erfarenhet av rekrytering, introduktion och personalplanering

    förståelse för ekonomi, budget och kostnadsuppföljning

    god förmåga att planera, prioritera och fatta beslut

    god kommunikativ förmåga på svenska och engelska

    ett genuint intresse för värdskap och gästupplevelser

    förmåga att arbeta självständigt och ta ansvar för helheten

Det är meriterande om du har erfarenhet av:

    fjäll-, destinations- eller säsongsverksamhet

    livsmedelshygien och egenkontroll

    arbetsmiljö- och säkerhetsarbete

    schemaläggning och arbete med kollektivavtal

    inköp, lager och logistisk planering

Som person är du

    trygg och tydlig i ditt ledarskap

    strukturerad och ekonomiskt medveten

    flexibel och lösningsorienterad

    prestigelös och operativ när det behövs

    närvarande och engagerad

    bekväm med att fatta beslut

    mån om både gästupplevelsen och medarbetarnas arbetsmiljö

Vi erbjuder

Hos oss får du möjlighet att leda och utveckla en verksamhet i en av Sveriges mest spektakulära fjällmiljöer.

Du får en roll med stort eget ansvar, korta beslutsvägar och möjlighet att påverka både arbetssätt, team och gästupplevelse.

Vi erbjuder:

    en tillsvidareanställning på heltid med provanställning på 6 månader

    en ledande roll med personal- och ekonomiansvar

    möjlighet att utveckla en unik fjällverksamhet

    en arbetsplats och vardag utöver det vanliga

    personalboende

    övriga personalförmåner

Anställningsvillkor

Befattning: Verksamhetsansvarig för Låktatjåkko fjällstationen

Placeringsort: Låktatjåkko Fjällstation/BjörklidenOmfattning: HeltidAnställningsform: TillsvidareanställningNärmaste chef: F&B-ansvarigTillträde: Omgående - enligt överenskommelse

Under högsäsong, februari–maj samt juli–september, arbetar du på Låktatjåkko. Under övriga delar av året ligger ett större fokus på planering och genomförande av middagar för Rakkaskåtan samt bröllop och andra F&B-relaterade arrangemang.

Arbetstiden planeras utifrån verksamhetens drift och behov. Arbete på kvällar och helger förekommer.

Urval och intervjuer sker löpande. Skicka därför gärna in din ansökan så snart som möjligt.

Välkommen till Låktatjåkko Fjällstation och en arbetsplats utöver det vanliga!

Har du frågor om tjänsten kan du ställa dem till Martina Dahlberg (HR partner) på ( martina.dahlberg@laplandresorts.se)

title: Associate Director, Clinical Regulatory Writing
description:
Are you passionate about transforming science into clear and compelling regulatory documents that drive successful drug development? We are seeking a talented and experienced Associate Director, Clinical Regulatory Writing to join our CVRM (Cardiovascular, Renal and Metabolism) Clinical Regulatory Writing team in Gothenburg, Sweden. With more than 2,400 employees from over 50 countries, our vibrant Gothenburg site is a truly inspiring place to work - where the history and future of scientific breakthroughs come together. We believe that the diversity of our people is crucial to bringing new discoveries to life.



Accountabilities:

The CVRM Clinical Regulatory Writing group provides expert strategic leadership and communications expertise to clinical drug programs, ensuring delivery of high-quality, label-focused documents aligned with project strategy, regulatory requirements, and communications best practices. Role holders not only author critical clinical-regulatory documents but also act as critical reviewers to achieve the highest quality standards. Team members also represent the Clinical Regulatory Writing skill set on both drug and non-drug projects, advocating for best practices and continuous improvement.



Key Responsibilities

As an Associate Director, Clinical Regulatory Writing, you will:

    

Provide strategic leadership and communication expertise to clinical drug programs across the CVRM portfolio.

    

Author and critically review clinical-regulatory documents, ensuring the highest regulatory, technical, and quality standards.

    

Represent Clinical Regulatory Writing on project teams, advocating for communication best practices.

    

Provide strategic communications leadership within clinical delivery or submission teams, establishing standards and promoting quality and efficiency.

    

Act as NDA/MAA submission lead, driving the development of the clinical Submission Communication Strategy (cSCS) and successful submission delivery.

    

Lead both internal and external authoring teams and cultivate strong partnerships with vendor medical writers to ensure timely, high-quality document delivery.

    

Translate complex clinical data into clear, concise, and accurate messages tailored to specific audiences.

    

Support the development and upskilling of colleagues within the Clinical Regulatory Writing function.

    

Champion continuous improvement and operational excellence in communications.



Essential Skills/Experience:

    

Bachelor's degree in Life Sciences or a related discipline.

    

Significant medical writing experience within the pharmaceutical industry or a Contract Research Organization (CRO).

    

Proven ability to advise and lead communications projects and teams.

    

Strong understanding of drug development and the communications process from early development through to launch and lifecycle management.

    

In-depth knowledge of technical and regulatory requirements relevant to clinical regulatory writing.



Desirable Skills/Experience:

    

Advanced degree in scientific discipline (e.g., Ph.D.).



If you are driven to deliver impactful regulatory communications, excel in multidisciplinary teams, and want to shape the future of clinical development, we encourage you to apply.



Apply with your CV and cover letter by 30 August!

title: Junior Cybersecurity Specialist – Identity & Access to Big Bank!
description:
We are looking for an Identity and Access Management (IAM) Consultant who will have the opportunity to grow and work on exciting projects, helping to shape secure authentication solutions at a leading bank in the financial sector!

About the role

As an IAM Consultant, you will play a key role in the onboarding process of applications to secure login solutions, specifically Single Sign-On (SSO). You will work closely with application owners, guiding them through the integration process and ensuring adherence to new guidelines. This highly collaborative role involves a lot of communication with stakeholders and solving technical challenges. You will gain valuable experience working in a high-paced, project-driven environment. This is a project assignment for the end of the year, to begin with.

You are offered

    Career growth within a leading financial company that values innovation, work-life balance, and diversity.
    Ongoing support from a dedicated consultant manager at Academic Work throughout your assignment.

Work tasks

We are looking for

It is meritorious if you have

    Previous experience working in an agile environment using Jira boards.

To succeed in the role, your personal skills are:

title: Exploration Manager
description:
Boliden is a high-tech metals company with its own mines and smelters that works long-term to guarantee society's access to base and precious metals. For a century, our work has been part of the value chains that have shaped modern society. At Boliden, we know that the metals we mine and make available will continue to play a crucial role in the future – what matters is how we produce them. Become a part of us and drive change for generations to come.

Your opportunity

Do you want to join us at Boliden and lead exploration strategy and discovery delivery across one of Europe’s most prospective mining regions?

We are looking for a Department Manager in Exploration to drive growth, prioritization, and value creation in the Central Fennoscandia region. The region is centred on the Skellefte District, one of Europe's premier volcanogenic massive sulphide (VMS) districts. It includes three operating mines, as well as several exploration ventures and projects.

Who you will work with

As Department Manager for Exploration in the Central Fennoscandia region, you are accountable for the full exploration value chain, from early-stage greenfield to near-mine initiatives across the Skellefte district.

Together with your first line managers, you lead the prioritization of exploration projects, balance long-term discovery potential with short-term business needs and allocate resources to maximize value creation and organic growth across the whole region.

What you will do

The department's goal is to extend the life of mine for all operating units within the region, provide opportunities for growing and expanding the operations, and search for new discoveries to sustain the region.

You will lead and develop the regional exploration portfolio, ensuring alignment with Boliden’s overall growth strategy and long-term resource development pipeline. You will also take part in discussions regarding project prioritization and ongoing exploration activities outside of your immediate area of responsibility.

The role includes:

    Strategic leadership - Contribute actively to overall exploration strategy, prioritization and investment decisions.
    Discovery alignment – Continuously assess and evaluate the growth potential of the region and align it with business goals and expectations.
    Resource & portfolio management - Own regional budgets, forecasts and portfolio performance, ensuring optimal allocation of capital across projects.
    Personnel – Lead three section managers with a total of around 30 employees.
    Safety, wellbeing & environmental performance – Ensure strong performance in safety, wellbeing and environmental responsibility across the department.
    Stakeholder & regulatory relations – Liaise with stakeholders and governmental authorities, while ensuring projects follow applicable laws and regulations for mining and exploration companies in each country.
    Contractor & consultant management – Negotiate with and manage cooperation with contractors and consultants.

You report to the Exploration Director and participate in Boliden’s Exploration Management Team, contributing to strategic decisions across the full exploration portfolio. The position is based at the Boliden Office or at one of Boliden Mines’ locations. Frequent travel is required, as well as regular presence at the Boliden Office.

What you bring

You have a university degree in geosciences and substantial experience in mineral exploration or mining, including a proven track record in leadership roles. You also have experience managing exploration portfolios, leading multidisciplinary teams, and working in complex stakeholder environments.

We place emphasis on your ability as a manager to motivate others and provide clear leadership in line with Boliden’s leadership principles. You are committed to developing the team, the region, and the company. You are results-oriented, with a focus on discovery and on creating both short- and long-term value. We expect you to share our values of Care, Courage, and Responsibility.

You need to be fluent in English. Swedish and/or Finnish language skills are considered a merit. A Category B driving licence is required.

Why work with us

At Boliden, we believe in promoting a workplace where care, courage, and responsibility are central to everything we do. We offer a workplace where we believe in collaboration and where what you contribute will have a direct impact on future generations. We are a company made up of responsible and creative people all working towards the same vision; to become the most sustainable and respected metal supplier in the world.

You will have a direct impact on shaping the future resource base of Boliden and have a role in delivering sustainable growth for the company.

Apply today to be part of something truly meaningful!

At Boliden, diversity and inclusion are drivers of innovation. We know that different perspectives and experiences strengthen us and help us stay at the forefront of an important and exciting industry. Therefore, we encourage applications from people with diverse backgrounds and viewpoints. Together, we build a workplace where everyone can feel safe and inspired to reach their full potential.

Want to know more about the position? Contact hiring manager Jon Keisu Lundh, +46 70 242 71 81, Jon.Lundh@boliden.com.

For questions about the application process, please contact Talent Acquisition Partner Terese Lindholm, terese.lindholm@boliden.com.

For union information please contact Mats Lindblom, SACO, +46 73 350 04 19, Andreas Mårtensson, Unionen, +46 70 541 83 93 and Peter Markström, Ledarna, +46 910 77 40 09.

Submit your application by: Sunday, 30 August 2026

We may select candidates for interviews on an ongoing basis, so don’t hesitate, send in your application. We look forward to it!

As part of Boliden’s qualitative recruitment efforts and systematic safety work, assessments and background checks may be included in the recruitment process.

If you are a representative of a recruiting company, please refrain from contacting us about this advertisement. We appreciate your consideration.

title: Senior Site Coordinator – Industrial Projects
description:
We are looking for a Site Coordinator for an exciting assignment with a leading international industrial company.

In this role, you will be responsible for coordinating and overseeing plant modification activities within a designated work package. You will ensure that all work is carried out safely, on schedule, within scope, and in accordance with the required quality standards.

You will report functionally to the Site Coordination Lead and work closely with the Work Package Owner on a day-to-day basis. As the primary on-site contact, you will support activities related to foundations, concrete works, and installations.

Key Responsibilities

    

Coordinate and oversee daily plant modification activities within the assigned work package, ensuring safe execution, timely delivery, and compliance with project scope and quality requirements.

    

Act as the primary point of contact between the project team, contractors, and subcontractors regarding on-site plant modification activities.

    

Monitor project progress, identify deviations, recommend improvements, and escalate issues or changes when necessary.

    

Track and report project status, progress, risks, and deviations to the Project Manager and Work Package Owner.

    

Provide technical support and guidance to resolve site-related issues associated with plant modification activities.

    

Ensure that all work complies with applicable technical, safety, and quality standards.

    

Proactively identify, assess, and mitigate risks that may impact project scope, schedule, or cost.

    

Escalate issues that may affect overall project delivery to the appropriate project stakeholders.

    

Support the evaluation of change requests and project variations by assessing their impact on cost, schedule, and quality.

    

Collaborate with other Site Coordinators and cross-functional project teams to ensure efficient coordination across interfaces.

    

Assist in preparing and reviewing daily, weekly, and monthly project reports, ensuring all documentation is accurate and up to date.

Applications are reviewed on an ongoing basis, and the assignment may be filled before the application deadline.

Requirements

    

Minimum of 7 years of experience in site coordination for large-scale infrastructure projects.

    

Strong knowledge of FG Condensate Treatment processes, Heat Pumps, plant modification methods, and construction practices, including site management and applicable health and safety regulations.

    

Fluency in English and Swedish, both spoken and written.

    

Proven experience coordinating on-site activities, overseeing contractor performance, and ensuring plant modification work is completed according to the work package and schedule.

    

Ability to coordinate site activities while ensuring alignment with the overall project timeline and budget.

    

A bachelor's degree in Engineering, Construction Management, or a related discipline is preferred. However, extensive hands-on experience in site coordination and execution of major infrastructure projects is considered equally or more valuable.

    

Demonstrated commitment to maintaining high standards of health, safety, and quality across all site operations.

Preferred Qualifications

    

Experience managing risks associated with plant modification activities, including safety-related risks and schedule delays.

    

Ability to perform effectively in a fast-paced, high-pressure site environment while maintaining focus on project objectives.

Personal Skills

    

Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.

    

Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making abilities to resolve on-site challenges effectively.

Additional Qualifications

    

Proactive approach to identifying and mitigating risks and resolving issues before they impact project delivery.

    

Strong ability to maintain safety, quality, and operational excellence throughout all site activities.

    

Comfortable working under pressure while ensuring successful project execution

title: Project Manager Service
description:
RaySearch develops innovative software solutions to improve cancer care. About 1000 clinics in more than 40 countries use RaySearch software to improve treatments and quality of life for patients. RaySearch was founded in 2000 and is listed on Nasdaq Stockholm. The headquarters is located in Stockholm, with subsidiaries in the US, Europe and Asia - Pacific. Today we are more than 400 employees with a common vision of improving cancer care with innovative software. Our great staff is crucial for our success and we offer a fantastic working environment in modern offices, flexibility and good opportunities for development. We believe in equal opportunities, value diversity and work actively to prevent discrimination.

Do you want to improve cancer care with innovative software? As Project Manager at RaySearch's Service Department, you will work with full product delivery and project implementation while collaborating with customers and colleagues globally. Join us in a quest to fight cancer!

About the role

As our Project Manager, you will belong to an expanding service organization and be part of our Global Service team. You will work with product deliveries across the RaySearch product suite, supporting clinics in Europe in implementing and deploying our oncology software solutions. You will lead several projects in parallel and work closely with Application Specialists, IT Specialists and other Project Managers. You will also collaborate with colleagues in Development, Finance and Sales Operations throughout your projects. When you start your position, you will get an introduction by your manager and work closely with a mentor who will help you familiarize yourself with our organization and ways of working.

You will be part of a growing Service department in a growing company that drives innovation in the MedTech industry. This is a full-time position at RaySearch’s head office located in Stockholm.

Your main tasks:

    Be the link between RaySearch and our customers during projects + lead the implementation and upgrade of projects.
    Be responsible for planning and coordination as well as follow-up on actions and deadlines.
    Act as intermediary between team members from Service, Development and Sales to coordinate the projects, and to participate in the allocation of resources in collaboration with Team Managers.
    Communicate with customers and internal stakeholders.
    Participate in activities to continuously improve internal processes and routines.

Your profile

To be successful in this position we think that you are a team player with excellent interpersonal skills who understand the importance of communication. Also, we believe that you are interested in innovative technology and curious to learn more about our products and the use and utility for our customers. You are not afraid of challenges, and you easily adapt to new situations and solve problems as they arise. Multitasking comes natural for you as you are both a strong organizer and administrator.

Requirements:

    2+ years’ experience from project delivery management within IT/MedTech.
    University degree (or equivalent) in relevant field.
    Experience in leadership and from working with structured project methodology.
    Great verbal and written communication skills in English.
    A service minded, positive attitude and ability to work independently.
    Experience from maintaining compliance and project documentation.

It is meriting if you have:

    Experience from the medtech and/or healthcare industry.
    Project management certifications.

Our Culture

Culture at RaySeach is the driving force behind our organization, where everything we do is driven by a shared passion for innovation and the fight against cancer. Our dedication is reflected in our ability to deliver exceptional results, pay close attention to detail, and consistently go the extra mile. Our employees stand out as experts in their field, driven by a relentless focus on solving problems, no matter how complex. At RaySearch, we take pride in leading the way in cancer treatment, leveraging cutting-edge technology to develop innovative solutions that make a real difference in patient care.

Our Offer

At RaySearch, we offer a diverse and inclusive work environment, fostering openness, sincerity, and collaboration. Located in Hagastaden, Stockholm's Life Science Hub, our modern and creative workspace includes an in-house gym, yoga, and social activities like ping pong, table football, and regular after-work events. Our bistro serves a fantastic lunch buffet, and we offer morning- and afternoon-fika every day. Our rooftop terrace also provides a stunning 360-degree view of Stockholm, enhancing the work experience. All of this comes attached with a competitive compensation and benefits package.

Application

Please apply to the position through the application form below. We do not accept applications by e-mail. Selection and interviews will be ongoing.

title: Application Experts to MIMER AI Factory, NAISS
description:
We have the power of over 50,000 students and co-workers. Students who provide hope for the future. Co-workers who contribute to Linköping University meeting challenges of today. Our fundamental values rest on credibility, trust and security. By having the courage to think freely and innovate, our actions together, large and small, contribute to a better world. We look forward to receiving your application!



Do you want to work at the forefront of Europe's AI development and contribute to building the next generation of AI infrastructure?

We are now looking for several AI Application Experts who want to contribute to the adoption and application of advanced AI methods across a wide range of domains, including technology and tools, data, life science, materials science, autonomous systems, training, and other emerging application areas.

These positions offer a unique opportunity to work with researchers, companies, public-sector organizations, and AI specialists within the EuroHPC AI Factory initiative and to help users transform ideas and data into impactful AI solutions.

The position

As an AI Application Expert, you will support users and projects in applying AI methods, tools, and workflows to real-world challenges. Depending on your background and interests, you may contribute within one or several application domains.

We welcome applicants with expertise in one or more of these domains. Candidates are not expected to cover all areas, and we encourage applications from specialists who can contribute strong expertise within their field.

The role combines hands-on technical work, user support, collaboration with domain experts, and participation in the development of AI services and best practices within MIMER and the wider European AI ecosystem.

Responsibilities

AI Application Support and Expertise

    Support researchers, companies, and public-sector organizations in the adoption and use of AI technologies
    Contribute expertise within one or more domains such as life science, materials science, autonomous systems, data science, AI tools, or training
    Help identify suitable AI methods, workflows, and technologies for specific use cases

Project and User Engagement

    Work directly with users to understand challenges and translate them into AI-enabled solutions
    Provide guidance on data preparation, model development, evaluation, and deployment
    Contribute to pilot projects, demonstrations, and proof-of-concept activities

Knowledge Sharing and Community Building

    Develop documentation, tutorials, training material, and examples
    Participate in workshops, training events, and outreach activities
    Contribute to building a strong national and European AI community

Collaboration and Innovation

    Collaborate with experts from academia, industry, and the public sector
    Help identify new opportunities for AI adoption and innovation
    Contribute to the continuous improvement of MIMER services and support offerings

The person we need

We are looking for someone who has:

    A Master's degree in AI, computer science, data science, engineering, life sciences, materials science, applied mathematics, or a related field
    Practical experience with AI, machine learning, data analytics, or related computational methods
    Ability to apply technical knowledge to real-world problems
    Experience working in research, industry, public-sector organizations, or innovation projects
    Interest in AI technologies and their practical application
    Ability to work in interdisciplinary and collaborative environments
    Strong communication skills and ability to engage with different stakeholder groups

It is particularly meriting if you have:

    Experience with modern AI methods such as generative AI, foundation models, or machine learning applications
    Experience with HPC, cloud computing, data platforms, or scientific computing environments
    Experience within one or more relevant domains such as life science, materials science, autonomous systems, public-sector AI, or industrial AI
    Experience developing training materials, providing user support, or working in collaborative projects
    Experience with European research infrastructures, EuroHPC, or international collaborations
    Excellent Swedish language skills

The workplace

MIMER AI Factory is part of a European initiative to strengthen the development of trustworthy and competitive AI in research, industry, and the public sector. Through advanced supercomputing infrastructure, expert support, and international collaboration, we enable the development of AI solutions across research, industry, and public administration. The activities are carried out in close collaboration between Linköping University, NAISS, and RISE.

The employment

Fixed-term employment for 1 year, full-time, 100%.

Starting date as soon as possible or by agreement.

The employment entails 10 positions as Applikationsexpert.

This position may come to be a security classified position. If so, security screening including a records check will be carried out before any decision on employment is made.

Salary and employment benefits

Linköping University is a Swedish public employer and offers individual salary setting, as well as opportunities to combine parenthood and an active lifestyle with employment.

NAISS offers a possibility of remote work up to 40% of the working time.

More information about employee benefits is available https://liu.se/en/work-at-liu/employee-benefits.

Union representatives

Information about union representatives, see https://liu.se/en/work-at-liu/hjalp%20for%20sokande.

Application procedure

Apply for the position by clicking the "Apply" button below. Your application must reach Linköping University no later than August 10th, 2026.

Applications and documents received after the date above will not be considered.

We welcome applicants with different backgrounds, experiences and perspectives - diversity enriches our work and helps us grow. Preserving everybody's equal value, rights and opportunities is a natural part of who we are. Read more about our work with: https://liu.se/en/article/lika-villkor/.

Job description:  At Volvo Group, our Cyber Defense Center (CDC) brings together the people, processes, and capabilities needed to protect our business and strengthen resilience in an increasingly digital world.  

This is an opportunity to lead one of the CDC's core operational capabilities, working alongside experienced cybersecurity professionals dedicated to detecting, responding to, and mitigating cyber threats that could impact our global operations.



The Head of the Cybersecurity Operations Center (CSOC) is a strategic and technical leader responsible for overseeing the operations, direction, and continuous improvement of the organization’s global Cybersecurity Operations Center. This role is responsible for ensuring the organization’s cyber defense capabilities remain cutting-edge, resilient, and responsive to emerging threats. The ideal candidate will bring deep expertise in cybersecurity, incident response, threat intelligence, and operational leadership.







What you will do



Strategic Leadership & CSOC Management:•    Develop and execute the CSOC strategy, ensuring alignment with overall cybersecurity and business objectives.•    Oversee and manage CSOC operations, including incident response, threat intelligence, and proactive monitoring.•    Define and refine security monitoring, threat detection, and response strategies to address evolving cyber threats.•    Continuously assess and improve CSOC processes, tools, and methodologies to enhance efficiency and effectiveness.•    Lead, mentor, and develop a high-performing CSOC team, ensuring continuous skills development and knowledge sharing.•    Establish key performance indicators (KPIs) and metrics to measure CSOC effectiveness and drive operational improvements.



Incident Response & Threat Management:•    Serve as the primary escalation point for major security incidents, overseeing coordination, investigation, containment, and remediation efforts.•    Collaborate with internal stakeholders and external partners to ensure swift and effective response to cybersecurity threats.•    Guide post-incident analysis and forensic investigations, ensuring lessons learned are integrated into future strategies.•    Maintain and enforce incident response procedures, ensuring adherence to regulatory and industry best practices.

      

Threat Intelligence & Emerging Threats:




    Stay ahead of evolving cyber threats, attack techniques, and emerging security trends.
    Leverage threat intelligence sources to enhance detection capabilities and proactively mitigate risks.
    Work with industry groups, government agencies, and vendors to strengthen the Volvo Group’s cyber defense posture.
    Ensure alignment with frameworks such as MITRE ATT&CK, NIST, and the Cyber Kill Chain to improve threat detection and response.



Collaboration & Compliance:




    Partner with IT, cybersecurity architecture, and compliance teams to ensure CSOC capabilities align with enterprise cybersecurity needs.
    Ensure CSOC operations comply with industry regulations, standards, and best practices (e.g., ISO 27001, NIST, GDPR).
    Communicate cybersecurity risks and CSOC performance to executive leadership, providing insights and recommendations.
    Develop strong relationships with third-party vendors, service providers, and law enforcement as needed.







Who are you?







Do you dream big? We do too, and we are excited to grow together. In this role, you will bring:








    Education & Experience


    Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Cybersecurity, Information Technology, or a related field (Master’s degree preferred).
    Experience: Minimum 7+ years of cybersecurity experience, with at least 4+ years in a SOC leadership role.
    Certifications: Preferred certifications include CISSP, CISM, CISA, GIAC (GCIA, GCIH, GSEC), or equivalent.






      
    Technical Expertise


    Extensive experience in security operations, incident response, digital forensics, and threat intelligence.
    Strong knowledge of SIEM, EDR, IDS/IPS, SOAR, and other security monitoring technologies.
    Deep understanding of cybersecurity frameworks, regulations, and best practices.
    Familiarity with scripting and automation (Python, PowerShell, etc.) to optimize SOC workflows.

  

      

Preferred Qualifications: •    Strong leadership and team management skills, with the ability to motivate and develop a high-performing SOC team.•    Excellent problem-solving, analytical, and decision-making capabilities.•    Ability to communicate complex cybersecurity issues to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.•    Experience working in a global enterprise environment, managing security operations across multiple regions.•    A forward-thinking mindset with the ability to anticipate and proactively address security challenges.

title: Senior Full-Stack Software Engineer
description:
About the Company

At Avaron, you get the security of permanent employment combined with the variety of working at different customers. We place specialists across everything from tech, IT and industry to project management and business support – and whatever the assignment, you have a consultant manager who is there for you and your development.

About the Role

You will join a product area that supports range planning for a global home furnishing retailer. The platform helps teams make data-driven decisions about article selection and supports both customer meeting point planning and retail establishment processes. In this role, you will help evolve a business-critical tool where product development, data integrations, and cloud modernization come together.

You will work across the full stack in a modern environment with Vue 3 on the frontend, Python and FastAPI on the backend, and integrations toward analytics and data platforms.     You will develop and maintain a Vue 3 single-page application using Vuetify and SCSS.

    You will help drive the cloud transition by supporting solutions that move from GCP and Kubernetes-based hosting toward Azure.
    You will implement secure authentication and contribute to secure API design.
    You will automate and maintain DBT pipelines that update BigQuery tables and support broader data pipeline work.
    You will enable and improve Excel export functionality using XlsxWriter.
    You will contribute to CI/CD, environment-based configuration, and collaborative development practices that keep the platform scalable and reliable.

Requirements

    5+ years of full-stack development experience

    Experience with Auth0 and Kubernetes
    Experience working with both GCP and Azure as cloud providers
    Familiarity with CI/CD, environment-based configuration, and secure API design
    Ability to write clean, scalable code in a collaborative development environment

Nice to have

    SQL
    GraphQL

    BigQuery
    Delta Sharing, Databricks, or similar analytics and data-platform integrations

What We Offer

title: Senior Tactical Buyer IT

As a leader in sustainable shipping, Stena Line has Europe's most comprehensive route network focusing on transportation of both passengers and freight. We have over 8,750 employees in our Stena Line family across Scandinavia, around the UK and the Baltics, making a contribution to our company.

title: Backend Developer
description:
Do you thrive in collaborative teams and want your work to shape what players experience every day?

As a Backend Developer at Snowprint, you’ll build the backend systems, infrastructure, and tools that power our games. You’ll work closely with your fellow developers, designers, and other disciplines to create stable, scalable solutions, always with the player experience in mind.

At Snowprint Studios, we believe that kindness, collaboration, curiosity, and self-leadership are what make great games possible. We work in small, cross-disciplinary teams where people are trusted to take ownership, share ideas openly, and continuously improve how we build games together.

What you’ll be doing

You'll bring new game features to life while also supporting the systems, tooling, and infrastructure behind them. The role combines feature development with live operations, giving you the opportunity to work on both player-facing functionality and the technical foundations that keep the game running.

You'll take ownership of the technical areas you work on, from planning and implementation to testing and live operations. A normal week might include feature development, playtests, troubleshooting production issues, discussing technical approaches with the team, and improving systems to support future needs as the game evolves.

You’ll collaborate closely with your colleagues to shape technical solutions that work well for both the game and the people building it.

Is this you?

You’re an experienced backend developer who is fluent in Kotlin and/or Java. You’ve worked with live backend services before (ideally gaming), and you’re comfortable operating cloud infrastructure (We use AWS).

You know how to troubleshoot complex issues in production environments and enjoy the mix of bug-fixing, fine-tuning, and forward-planning that comes with live operations.

You communicate clearly, ask questions, and enjoy working through problems with your colleagues. You’re self-directed but collaborative, happy to own your part of a feature while staying connected to the bigger picture. You care about the player experience, and you bring that mindset into technical discussions.

Where you’ll work

Our Stockholm studio is located in Södermalm, and we work in a hybrid setup. We work from the office on Tuesdays and Fridays to support collaboration and social interaction, while other days offer flexibility depending on where you work best. We provide the setup and tools you need to work comfortably both at home and in the studio.

About Snowprint Studios

Snowprint Studios believes great games are created by teams of talented, kind and creative individuals in a friendly, supportive and inspiring environment - while maintaining a sustainable life-work balance. For more information on Snowprint Studios go to snowprintstudios.com and follow us on Facebook.

At Snowprint Studios, we embrace diversity both in the worlds we create and in our workplace. Join us in shaping the future of gaming!

    

Pocket Gamer Awards Winner ‘Mobile game of the year’ and ‘Best strategy game’ 2022

    

Pocket Gamer Awards Winner 'Best game we are still playing’ 2024 & 2026

    

Pocket Gamer Awards Finalist, ‘Best developer’ 2025

    

Pocket Gamer Awards Winner, ‘Best updated game’ & ‘Best community’ 2026

Good to know

We are an international company with many nationalities represented. Our company language is English, so your application should therefore be in English.

title: Functional Safety Engineer
description:
Company description:

Epiroc is a leading productivity partner for the mining, infrastructure and natural resources industries. Withcutting-edge technology, Epiroc develops and produces innovative drill rigs, rock excavation and constructionequipment, and provides world-class service and consumables. The company was founded in Stockholm,Sweden, and has passionate people supporting and collaborating with customers in more than 150 countries.Learn more at www.epirocgroup.com.

Job description:

Join Us in Transforming the Future!







It all starts with people. People like you.







About Us







At Epiroc, innovation and collaboration are at the core of everything we do. Our vision is clear: to accelerate the transformation of mining towards a greener, safer and more sustainable industry. In this role, you’ll have the opportunity to work at the forefront of system development, contributing to safe and compliant solutions that support the next generation of automation and control systems.







Your Mission







As a Functional Safety Engineer, you play a key role in developing and supporting safety-related functions across our systems. You ensure compliance with applicable standards and legal requirements, contributing to robust, reliable, and high-quality solutions.







You lead and support risk assessments, develop safety concepts, and drive verification and validation activities. In addition, you are responsible for documenting functional safety processes and act as a specialist supporting cross-functional teams within the product line. You actively contribute to competence development, consistency, and continuous improvement within safety-related development. The role may also take a leading part in our work to fulfil upcoming regulatory requirements, including the Cyber Resilience Act (CRA) and the Data Act, ensuring that our products and development practices align with new compliance expectations.







In this role, you collaborate closely across disciplines, influencing technical solutions and ensuring that safety is integrated throughout the product lifecycle.







Your Profile







You are a structured and quality-driven professional with strong ownership and a proactive approach to risk management. You collaborate effectively, communicate clearly, and influence safety-related decisions with confidence.







To succeed in this role, you bring a combination of analytical thinking, system understanding, and passion for safety-critical development. You thrive in cross-functional environments and continuously seek to improve both solutions and ways of working.







Other requirements:




    Strong competence in functional safety, including risk assessment, safety concept development, and application of standards such as ISO 12100 and ISO 13849
    Experiene from CRA and Data Act is meriting
    Broad system understanding across electrics, software, and control systems
    Experience from system design and safety-critical development
    Experience working in cross-functional environments
    Strong communication and documentation skills







Why Epiroc?







By joining our team, you’ll make a big difference in the energy transition. At Epiroc, we take pride in being passionate innovators, driving the change toward a brighter future for both people and the planet. Guided by our values of Collaboration, Commitment, and Innovation, we foster a culture of trust, growth, and lasting impact.







To support your journey, we offer a competitive Total Rewards Package, including:




    Global career opportunities
    Learning & Development programs
    Benefits package, including variable compensation (bonus)
    Flexible work culture promoting balance and well-being
    Global Parental Leave Policy
    Community involvement







Location and Travel







This position is based in Örebro, Sweden.







Application and Contact Information







Submit your application as soon as possible through our online system. The last day to apply is August 30, 2026. We review applications continuously.







Our recruitment process includes interviews, reference checks, and assessments. We conduct identity checks and drug and alcohol screening to ensure a safe working environment. Expect transparent communication and a fair evaluation of your skills and experience.







For questions, contact:







Hiring Manager Thomas Johansson: thomas.johansson@epiroc.com



Recruitment Specialist Zuzana Kalivodova: zuzana.kalivodova@epiroc.com

Send your personal letter and CV, along with any relevant qualifications, to:

jobs.jonkoping@engelska.se

title: Electrical and Communication Engineering
description:
Role Overview:

The Electrical Engineer is responsible for overseeing all aspects of the Electrical discipline cover other construction areas as required. This includes ensuring compliance with design specifications, technical standards, and project requirements while aligning with cost, schedule, and safety objectives. Electrical Engineer closely collaborates with Plant Unit Project Managers, Construction Managers, and other cross-functional Technical Project Managers to ensure seamless integration of Electrical tasks.

Key responsibilities include managing contractors and suppliers, monitoring progress and costs, mitigating technical risks, electrical and communication design, and ensuring quality and documentation standards are met. The role also supports procurement with technical input, evaluates change requests, and drives continuous improvement by applying lessons learned.

Key Responsibilities:

· Manage all tasks related to the technical discipline, ensuring compliance with design specifications, technical standards, and project requirements.

· Ensure that all work aligns with design-to-cost and schedule objectives.

· Work with Plant Unit Project Managers and Construction Managers to integrate discipline-specific work into the overall plant unit, ensuring smooth coordination and alignment with plant unit goals.

· Provide updates on discipline-specific progress to the Technical Discipline Manager and escalate issues when necessary.

· Oversee the work of contractors and suppliers related to their discipline, ensuring that work is completed on time and to the required quality standards.

· Identify technical risks and work with both the Technical Discipline Manager and Plant Unit Project Manager to resolve issues and mitigate risks.

· Ensure all technical work is properly documented and that progress is reported regularly to the Plant Unit Project Manager and Technical Discipline Manager. Align with suppliers and contractors

· Making standard documents as per project requirements and as per standards

· Familiar with electrical engineering software like ETAP, SPF, and DIALUX.

· Familiar with SS EN Standards such as SS 4364000, SS EN 50522, SS EN 50110 Elsäkerhetsverket (ELSÄK-FS)

· In-depth knowledge of MV/LV power distribution systems and electrical equipment.

· Pre-commissioning for electrical equipment such as panels, transformers, motors, and so on.

· Familiar with the design and installation of switchgear, Transformers, cables, and bus ducts.

· Factory Acceptance Test witness in international companies.

· Strong knowledge of workplace safety & experience in a broad range of safety procedures.

· Ensure that all technical aspects align with project goals, including safety, budget, scope, and schedule.

· Provide expertise and guidance on discipline-specific methodologies and best practices.

· Support procurement with technical input during contract negotiations.

· Review and approve all deliverables within the discipline to ensure quality standards and specifications are met.

· Assess resource needs to ensure that project goals are met.

· Adjust team activities as necessary to meet project timelines and objectives.

· Identify areas for process improvements within the discipline.

· Implement lessons learned from past projects to enhance future performance.

Competencies and experience:

· Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering.

· Minimum of 8 years of experience within the design, construction, and installation of Electrical systems.

· Good knowledge of the technical aspects of Electrical systems within industrial projects.

· Strong leadership and management skills.

· Excellent problem-solving and decision-making abilities.

· Effective communication and interpersonal skills.

· Fluent in Swedish and English, both spoken and written.
